title: Head of Hunter Platform and Products - DA
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Experian unlocks the power of data to create opportunities for consumers, businesses and society. We gather, analyze and process data in ways others can’t. We help individuals take financial control and access financial services, businesses make smarter decision and thrive, lenders lend more responsibly, and organizations prevent identity fraud and crime. For more than 125 years, we’ve helped consumers and clients prosper, and economies and communities flourish – and we’re not done. Our 17,800 people in 45 countries believe the possibilities for you, and our world, are growing. We’re investing in new technologies, talented people and innovation so we can help create a better tomorrow.

Job Description

Experian India is seeking a strategic and visionary senior leader to head its Fraud and ID Verification Solutions team. This client-facing role is central to driving solution excellence, market leadership, and product innovation in the financial services sector. The ideal candidate will be a recognized expert in fraud prevention and identity verification, capable of translating client challenges into impactful solutions while influencing product strategy and market execution.

In today’s era of data-driven decision-making, Experian is uniquely positioned to solve client problems by being at the forefront of data analysis, solutioning, and innovation. Our platform-first approach enables seamless integration of data from multiple sources, creating a one-stop solution for the financial industry in India.

Key Responsibilities

Client Engagement & Strategic Solutioning

  • Lead a team of specialists to engage with clients, deeply understand their fraud and ID verification challenges, and strategically position Experian’s solutions to address these needs.
  • Collaborate with Sales teams on day-to-day sales activities, providing strategic guidance and solution expertise to support deal progression and closure.
  • Ensure that analytics-driven insights are embedded into client conversations and product evolution.
  • Ensure that proposed solutions are optimal, scalable, and aligned with client needs and regulatory frameworks.

Post-Sales Success & Adoption

  • Oversee the transition from sales to onboarding, ensuring smooth implementation and client satisfaction.
  • Drive client adoption and usage of solutions, acting as a strategic advisor to maximize value realization.

Product Feedback & Innovation

  • Serve as the voice of the customer to internal product teams, providing actionable insights on product performance and enhancement opportunities.
  • Influence the development of new features and capabilities based on client feedback and market trends.
  • Work closely with Experian’s highly proficient analytics teams to co-create innovative, data-led solutions.
  • Identify trends across liabilities and assets onboarding, spanning both consumer and MSME segments.
  • Leverage advanced analytics to address fraud not only from a consumer perspective but also through digital device footprints, behavioral signals, and emerging fraud typologies.

Go-To-Market Strategy

  • Partner with GTM and sales teams to launch new Fraud and ID Verification products.
  • Define target segments, positioning, messaging, and market entry strategies.
  • Support enablement and training of sales teams on new offerings.

Industry Leadership & Advocacy

  • Represent Experian at fraud forums, conferences, and industry events.
  • Establish Experian as the leading authority on fraud and ID verification in India’s financial services sector.
  • Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders across banks, NBFCs, and regulatory bodies.

Community Building & Thought Leadership

  • Lead the planning and execution of the Annual Fraud Closed User Group Summit for Hunter platform users and industry leaders.
  • Manage the Hunter Advisory Board, a quarterly forum of top financial institutions to discuss product evolution and regulatory developments.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Collaborate across product, customer success, onboarding, analytics, and GTM teams to drive holistic client outcomes.
  • Inspire and lead a high-performing team of specialists, fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and innovation.

Qualifications

Qualifications & Experience:

  • 15+ years of experience in fraud prevention, identity verification, or related domains within financial services or technology.
  • Proven experience in strategic client engagement and solutioning.
  • Strong understanding of the fraud landscape in India’s financial services sector.
  • Experience in product strategy, GTM planning, and cross-functional leadership.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and strategic thinking skills.
  • Prior experience in hosting industry summits or advisory boards is a plus.

What Success Looks Like

  • Strategic influence on sales outcomes and client satisfaction.
  • High adoption and usage rates post-implementation.
  • Strong market presence and thought leadership in the fraud domain.
  • Continuous product improvement driven by client insights.
  • Seamless collaboration across internal teams and external stakeholders.
  • Delivery of innovative, data-driven solutions that address emerging fraud patterns.

Why us

  • We’re a high-performance and driven team but we don’t forget to celebrate success
  • We offer strong career and international opportunities for high performers
  • We invest heavily in our products and our people
  • We offer training and support from experienced subject matter experts and managers plus dedicated learning & development time

Additional Information

  • We are looking for someone who:
  • Is a consultative business professional
  • Is confident, clear, certain and consistent
  • Is able to work alongside a sales team managing multiple opportunities concurrently
  • Passionate, resourceful, gracious and adaptable
  • High moral standards, honesty and an ethical approach to doing business
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving skills and ability to see the big-picture & develop conceptual solutions
  • Candidates that have prior relevant work experience, excel in ambiguous situations, and possess a passion for helping companies become more competitive
  • Business acumen combined with a comfort with technology is a must

Experian Careers - Creating a better tomorrow together

Find out what its like to work for Experian by clicking here

title: VP- Lead Product Owner- Issuer Services
descriptionHtml:
The Lead Product Owner is a hands-on position responsible for liaising between key Business / Product stakeholders across the firm and technology to exchange information in a concise and understandable way to promote development and delivery, operational stability, and quality process improvements, adhering to and implementing Agile principles on the assigned teams.

The individual will be an agile practitioner, with product and business knowledge with an attitude of continuous improvement. With experience of leading and managing people.

Lead Product owners will be responsible for managing the team, developing and executing the vision of how the product should function, define specific product features, and break those features into product backlog items and prioritize for the Scrum team to work on.

Works with Business Stakeholders and Product Managers to build the product vision, product roadmap and release Plan.

Responsibilities:

  • The Lead Product owner will be responsible for developing and executing the vision of how the product should function, define specific product features, and break those features into product backlog items and prioritize for the Scrum team to work on.
  • Managing the product owner team to support delivery, business prioritisation and focus.
  • Developing and explicitly communicating the Product Goal; Creating and clearly communicating Product Backlog Items; Ordering Product Backlog Items; Ensuring that the Product Backlog is transparent, visible, and understood.
  • Facilitate Agile development process, create and sustain high performing Agile teams, and help them deliver high quality software
  • Participate in all needed agile ceremonies including but not limited to sprint planning, refinements, sprint review, retros, and daily standups, scrum of scrums and monthly release deployment activities.
  • Work closely with Scrum Master and tech lead to ensure execution efficiency by through efficient sprint planning, maintaining optimal velocity, code quality and promotion of code into production
  • Work closely with the Business/Product Heads and Scrum Master/tech lead in the adoption of Agile software development practices (creating product roadmaps and backlogs tied to business value delivery, high quality user stories, release schedules and delivery planning, scrum meetings, velocity, and capacity planning)
  • Work closely with Scrum Master and tech lead to generate and monitor periodic reporting on team’s performance using Agile metrics - burndowns, Cumulative Flow Diagrams, Control Charts, sprint reports, test reports etc. to provide statistical proof of momentum and sustainability.
  • Familiarity with SAFe framework and Program Increment planning. Collaborate with RTE to conduct PI planning sessions with Agile team members and stakeholders to ensure alignment on objectives and priorities of upcoming PI.
  • Encourage Agile way of thinking for delivering business value for all team members and lead by example
  • Subject matter expert in confluence & JIRA including creation of swim lanes and dashboard, running JQL queries and customizing filters, JIRA report extraction and bulk uploads etc.
  • Influence a wide range of stakeholders (business, compliance, Legal, IT, etc.) to remove impediments and maximize team output.
  • Encourage an environment where an open communication and collaborative problem solving can pave the way for faster removal of any impediments, and where the impact of mistakes can be minimized through early detection, making them into learning opportunities.
  • Work closely with Scrum Master and tech lead to Identify, manage, and help mitigate issues and risks, with particular emphasis on timely removal of impediments for the team and/or directing obstacles to appropriate owners for quick resolution.
  • Work closely with Scrum Master and tech lead to facilitate discovering and enacting continuous improvement strategies to increase the productivity of the team and quality of deliverables including the Code Quality and app monitoring setup etc.
  • Compliance with Citibank policies and procedures for project delivery.
  • Partner with Agile coach and other agile teams to share findings, best practices, and resources to help mature the organizations agility.

Recommended Qualifications:

  • 3-5 years of experience within Product Owner and/or Product Management role and experience of the software development life cycle
  • Deep understanding of Agile methodology and frameworks (Kanban, Scrum, Lean, SAFe etc.)
  • Experience leading large scale enterprise transformation projects with global and cross functional teams in Agile environment
  • Excellent interpersonal communication and facilitation skills and proven ability to work with Global teams
  • Proficiency in JIRA, MS Office Tools with strong data analysis skills using MS Excel
  • Intellectual curiosity, analytical and conceptual thinker
  • Proactively seeks and develops new opportunities
  • Attention to detail and process/analytic mindset
  • Ability to build networks and relationships internally and externally
  • Ability to collaborate and clearly communicate with team members of an organization
  • Project Management skills with experience leading large cross functional initiatives

Education:

  • Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience

Nice to have:

  • Experience in Capital Markets, Securities Services / Issuer Services / investment management within financial industry is a plus

Certifications/Qualifications:

  • Certified Product Owner / Scrum Master (CSM), PMI-ACP (Agile Certified Practitioner), SAFe Scrum Master or similar certification
  • Bachelor's degree/University degree or equivalent experience
  • Master's degree preferred

This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.

The Team lead will report to the Global Head of Product Execution and Governance with a matrix to the India Cluster Head.

title: Director of Product Management – AI Platform (Compute, Integrations & Cloud Infrastructure)
descriptionHtml:
Our Company

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

What You’ll Do

In this role, you will serve as a senior Products leader driving Teradata’s AI product management strategy across our global portfolio. You will define and influence how Teradata integrates AI/ML technologies into our enterprise-scale data and analytics platforms.

Your impact will be shaping how customers harness Teradata’s VantageCloud and data warehouse capabilities through AI-driven insights, automation, and intelligent applications. You will set the roadmap for embedding AI into mission-critical workloads, balancing innovation with performance, governance, and compliance.

Success in this role will be measured by delivering enterprise-grade AI solutions optimized for hybrid and multi-cloud deployments, unlocking measurable customer value while ensuring scalability, reliability, and cost-efficiency of AI workloads.

Who You Will Work With

On our team, we collaborate with engineering, cloud infrastructure, data science, UX, and governance functions to bring next-generation AI capabilities into Teradata’s enterprise ecosystem. We are responsible for the product vision, roadmap, and execution of AI initiatives, ensuring they meet both business and technical objectives.

This role reports to the VP of Product Management and will partner closely with product engineering and platform leaders worldwide. You will act as the strategic AI product leader for Teradata, influencing global product direction.

What Makes You a Qualified Candidate

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or related field (PhD preferred).
  • 10+ years of product management experience, including 5+ years leading AI/ML or advanced analytics products.
  • Deep technical expertise in AI/ML concepts, including LLMs, foundation models, supervised/unsupervised learning, fine-tuning, inference pipelines, and multi-modal AI.
  • Proven success embedding AI into enterprise-scale platforms, especially in data management, analytics, or cloud environments.
  • Strong technical fluency with AI infrastructure — including distributed training, inference optimization, GPU/accelerator integration, and workload orchestration.
  • Experience defining APIs, SDKs, and developer integrations for enterprise AI adoption.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of hybrid and multi-cloud architectures and their impact on AI performance, scalability, and cost optimization.
  • Familiarity with governance and compliance frameworks (HIPAA, GDPR, SOC2) and applying them to AI/ML solutions.
  • Exceptional communication skills with the ability to influence C-level stakeholders and articulate AI product strategy.
  • Track record of customer engagement, market analysis, and competitive benchmarking in enterprise software.

What You Will Bring

  • Expertise in optimizing AI workloads across cloud and hybrid environments, ensuring cost-efficiency and performance at scale.
  • Hands-on knowledge of GPU, TPU, and emerging accelerator technologies for training, inference, and fine-tuning AI models.
  • Ability to bridge AI model development with structured and unstructured enterprise data at petabyte scale.
  • A strong understanding of responsible AI, including fairness, explainability, auditability, and bias detection.
  • Vision to anticipate industry trends and position Teradata’s AI offerings as differentiated and enterprise-ready.
  • Passion for enabling intuitive, AI-powered user experiences (e. g. , natural language query, automated insights, intelligent automation).
  • Ability to operate as a senior leader — setting strategy, guiding technical direction, and influencing globally.

Why We Think You'll Love Teradata

We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are committed to actively working to foster an inclusive environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.

title: Director - Markets - National - CBS - MKT - Global Markets/Client Service - New Delhi
descriptionHtml:
Requisition Id: 1656836

As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. We believe that it’s your career and ‘It’s yours to build’ which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self.

The opportunity : Director-National-Markets-CBS - MKT - Global Markets/Client Service - New Delhi

National :

National comprises of sector agnostic teams working across industries for a well rounded experience.

CBS - MKT - Global Markets/Client Service :

Our Markets team focuses on providing account teams with the support they need to help drive revenue growth. Our "account-centric" approach to serving clients starts with understanding their business and providing tools and enablers to provide consistency on how we identify and align our services and solutions to our clients' most pressing issues. We deliver services through one or more of our four global service lines: Assurance, Consulting, Strategy and Transactions and Tax. Our Markets team comprises of Business Development and Brand Media & Communication (BMC).

By adopting EY methodologies, executing on guidance, and leveraging tools and strategic programs, we bring the necessary rigor to our engagements. And by accessing our latest EY insights, solutions and client conversation tools, we have more meaningful conversations with our clients to help shape their thinking and generate additional value creation.

Your Key Responsibilities

Technical Excellence

  • The Director of Product will be responsible for driving the product vision, strategy, and execution across a portfolio of enterprise and SaaS platforms. This leader will work closely with business stakeholders, engineering, design, and data teams to build scalable, AI-enabled solutions that address real client needs while strengthening EY’s technology foundation. Key Responsibilities: Define and execute the roadmap for scalable SaaS and enterprise-grade products that align with EY’s strategic priorities and deliver measurable business impact. Ensure deep understanding of client needs, competitive landscape, and market trends to shape differentiated, high-value propositions. Translate complex AI technologies into intuitive, user-centric functionalities that simplify workflows and elevate user experience. Build, lead, and mentor a team of product managers, instilling a culture of innovation, accountability, and excellence in product thinking. Partner with engineering, design, and business teams to deliver high-quality, reliable, and usable products within defined timelines. Champion usability and functional simplicity, ensuring products go beyond automation to create tangible business unlocks. Communicate priorities clearly, align stakeholders across functions, and ensure transparency on progress, risks, and dependencies. Key Requirements: Proven track record in designing and executing scalable SaaS products, balancing user needs and market demands. Strong leadership experience managing and mentoring product teams in complex, multi-stakeholder environments. Deep understanding of AI technologies and their practical application in product design and automation. Exceptional communication and collaboration skills with the ability to translate technical complexity into business clarity. Demonstrated success in driving adoption, usability, and measurable business outcomes through thoughtful product design. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a bias for action and ownership. 12–18 years of total experience with at least 5+ years in senior product leadership roles. Why EY: At EY, we are reimagining how technology can create trust, transparency, and efficiency across industries. This role offers the opportunity to lead at the intersection of AI, design, and enterprise technology—building products that power the next phase of digital transformation for clients and the firm.

Skills And Attributes

To qualify for the role you must have

Qualification

  • Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science or a technical degree
  • Master of Business Administration (optional)

Experience

  • Full Stack Development (4+ years)
  • Machine Learning (1+ years)
  • Product Management (8+ years)
  • Artificial Intelligence (1+ years)

What We Look For

People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

What We Offer

Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market-leading growth over competitors. Our people work side-by-side with market-leading entrepreneurs, game-changers, disruptors, and visionaries. As an organization, we are investing more time, technology, and money than ever before in skills and learning for our people. At EY, you will have a personalized Career Journey and also the chance to tap into the resources of our career frameworks to better know about your roles, skills, and opportunities.

EY is equally committed to being an inclusive employer, and we strive to achieve the right balance for our people—enabling us to deliver excellent client service while allowing our people to build their careers as well as focus on their wellbeing.

If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

Join us in shaping the future with confidence. Apply Now

title: Chief of Staff -  Product
descriptionHtml:
Who Are We?

RZR is an AI-native advertising platform built for the next era of performance marketing. We operate at the intersection of machine learning, programmatic media, and full-funnel mobile growth, powering campaigns for some of the world's most ambitious advertisers. Our platform is purpose-built to deliver outcomes at scale, not just impressions.

We are a team of builders, operators, and technologists who believe the advertising industry is overdue for a fundamental rethink. We move fast, operate with a high degree of ownership, and hold ourselves to an exceptionally high standard of craft.

RZR is scaling aggressively with an active M&A pipeline and a platform vision that puts us on a path to becoming an industry leader. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at an inflection point and help shape what it becomes.

Role Overview

The Chief of Staff, Product is a high-impact, high-trust role at the center of RZR's product organization. You will work as a direct partner to the VP of Product — not as a scheduler or note-taker, but as an operator and force multiplier who translates roadmap direction into clear plans, owned milestones, and measurable outcomes.

You will work across Engineering, Design, Analytics, GTM, and Finance, removing execution friction, improving decision quality, and ensuring the organisation stays focused on its highest-leverage product work. You'll own the product operating cadence end-to-end, build executive materials for board and leadership reviews, run deep-dive analyses when needed, and step in directly to drive critical initiatives from problem definition through delivery.

The ideal candidate is a sharp operator and analytical thinker who is genuinely comfortable in ambiguity, can hold their own in any cross-functional room, and cares deeply about outcomes — not activity or optics.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end execution of high-priority product and cross-functional initiatives, from problem definition through delivery and follow-through
  • Translate roadmap direction and product strategy into clear plans, milestones, ownership structures, and success metrics
  • Partner with leaders across Engineering, Design, Analytics, GTM, Finance, and People to manage dependencies and ensure timely delivery
  • Own the product operating cadence: roadmap reviews, quarterly and sprint planning, OKR tracking, and executive product reviews
  • Build structured analyses, decision memos, and business cases to support product leadership in high-stakes decisions
  • Run product and usage deep dives directly when needed to unblock decisions or accelerate outcomes
  • Prepare leadership materials for product reviews, board discussions, and strategic planning cycles
  • Track progress against product priorities and ensure decisions are documented, communicated, and executed across the organisation
  • Step in flexibly to cover execution gaps on critical product initiatives as business needs evolve

Required Skills And Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field
  • 5+ years in Chief of Staff, Product Operations, Strategy, Business Operations, Consulting, Program Management, or Product Management — ideally in or adjacent to a product organisation
  • Proven track record leading complex, cross-functional initiatives in fast-paced, high-growth environments
  • Strong analytical skills: structuring ambiguous problems, interpreting product and usage data, and translating insight into action
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, with experience creating executive-ready materials for senior leadership and boards
  • Demonstrated ability to influence and drive outcomes without direct authority across senior cross-functional partners
  • High ownership and bias to action; comfort managing multiple competing priorities with limited direction
  • Nice to have: experience in technology, ad tech, or product-led businesses; familiarity with product analytics, roadmapping, or OKR frameworks; MBA or advanced degree

Why Join RZR?

  • Direct seat at the table on product strategy — you'll partner daily with VP-level product leadership on the decisions that shape RZR's roadmap and future
  • Unmatched cross-functional exposure across Engineering, Design, GTM, Finance, and executive leadership, including board-level visibility from day one
  • A genuine force-multiplier role with real, organisation-wide ownership — your work will be visible at every level, not buried in a support function
  • High-trust, high-autonomy environment where outcomes matter more than titles or process — no bureaucracy, no busywork
  • Scaling a profitable, post-turnaround ad tech company into its next phase of operational and product maturity — you'll help define how the org runs
  • Clear growth path into product management, product operations, or general management for the right person

RZR Behaviors

RZR operates by eight core behaviors: Extreme Ownership

  • Move Fast
  • Drive for Excellence
  • Proactive Communication
  • Courage
  • Curiosity
  • Deliver Results
  • Manage Ambiguity

title: Director Global Product Management & Upstream Marketing
descriptionHtml:
At Fresenius Medical Care, we are the global leader in kidney care, committed to improving the lives of patients with chronic kidney disease. Our mission is to deliver high-quality, innovative products, services, and care across the entire healthcare journey. Guided by our vision—“Creating a future worth living. For patients. Worldwide. Every day.”—we work with purpose and compassion, supported by a global team of over 110.000 employees.

Within our Care Enablement segment, we develop and provide life-sustaining medical products, digital health solutions, and therapies that empower clinical teams and improve patient outcomes. Our FME Reignite strategy drives transformation through innovation, efficiency, and sustainable growth.

Our values guide how we work:


  • We Care for our patients, each other, and our communities
  • We Connect across teams and borders to deliver excellence together
  • We Commit to doing things the right way— growing with purpose and leading kidney care with integrity and innovation


In-Center as one of three therapy verticals focuses on delivering high-quality, clinic-based hemodialysis to patients worldwide. Its mission is to support healthcare providers in offering safe, consistent, and patient-centered care in dialysis clinics.

The team collaborates across Product Design, Clinical Protocols, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Regulatory, and Commercial functions to equip clinics with effective, innovative solutions that meet high standards and improve patient outcomes. Join our passionate team and help shape healthcare worldwide!

The Director, Product Management & Upstream Marketing is responsible for defining and driving the global portfolio strategy and lifecycle management, with a strong focus on profitability, competitiveness, and sustainability. The role leads the entry and value‑segment strategy and ensures portfolio alignment with overall business objectives, particularly in highly price‑sensitive and tender‑driven markets. Join our passionate team and help shape healthcare worldwide!

Your Responsibilities:


  • Define and drive the global portfolio strategy, including lifecycle management, optimization, and rationalization
  • Lead the entry and value‑segment strategy to ensure strong competitiveness in price‑sensitive markets
  • Manage portfolio trade‑offs to balance growth, profitability, and complexity
  • Identify and drive initiatives to improve cost, margin, and portfolio efficiency
  • Align closely with value streams and senior leadership on portfolio priorities and decisions
  • Partner with regional and country teams on pricing, tenders, and market‑specific portfolio strategies
  • Develop a deep understanding of competitive dynamics and define response strategies against low‑cost competitors
  • Support countries in the preparation and execution of requests for proposals (RFPs)
  • Provide structured product and portfolio training in collaboration with HQ functions
  • Build strong working relationships with global sales, marketing, and cross‑functional teams
  • Engage senior leadership with clear updates on portfolio performance, risks, and strategic initiatives
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal SOPs


Your Profile:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Life Sciences, or equivalent; MBA or advanced degree in Marketing, Strategy, or General Management
  • 15+ years of experience in product management within the medical device or healthcare industry
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
  • Demonstrated experience managing global portfolios across the full product lifecycle
  • Proven leadership and collaboration skills across cross‑functional and global teams, including the ability to lead and influence within complex matrix organizations without direct authority, with a self‑motivated, results‑oriented approach and comfort operating in dynamic and changing environments
  • Deep market and therapy‑area knowledge, ideally in dialysis or renal care
  • Strong expertise in upstream marketing, portfolio strategy, and lifecycle management
  • Medical‑technical knowledge of hemodialysis products and therapies
  • Experience or familiarity with digital marketing, marketing automation, and project management tools


Our Offer for you:

There is a lot you can discover at Fresenius Medical Care, regardless in which field you are an expert and how much experience you have - all dedicated to your professional journey.


  • Whether in front of or behind the scenes - you are helping to make ever better medicine available to more and more people around the world
  • Individual opportunities for self-determined career planning and professional development
  • A corporate culture in which there is enough room for innovative thinking - to find the best solution together, not the quickest one
  • A large number of committed people with a wide range of skills, talents and experience
  • The benefits of a successful global corporation with the collegial culture of a medium-sized company

title: Director of Product Management – AI Platform (Compute, Integrations & Cloud Infrastructure)
descriptionHtml:
Our Company

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

What You’ll Do

In this role, you will serve as a senior Products leader driving Teradata’s AI product management strategy across our global portfolio. You will define and influence how Teradata integrates AI/ML technologies into our enterprise-scale data and analytics platforms.

Your impact will be shaping how customers harness Teradata’s VantageCloud and data warehouse capabilities through AI-driven insights, automation, and intelligent applications. You will set the roadmap for embedding AI into mission-critical workloads, balancing innovation with performance, governance, and compliance.

Success in this role will be measured by delivering enterprise-grade AI solutions optimized for hybrid and multi-cloud deployments, unlocking measurable customer value while ensuring scalability, reliability, and cost-efficiency of AI workloads.

Who You Will Work With

On our team, we collaborate with engineering, cloud infrastructure, data science, UX, and governance functions to bring next-generation AI capabilities into Teradata’s enterprise ecosystem. We are responsible for the product vision, roadmap, and execution of AI initiatives, ensuring they meet both business and technical objectives.

This role reports to the VP of Product Management and will partner closely with product engineering and platform leaders worldwide. You will act as the strategic AI product leader for Teradata, influencing global product direction.

What Makes You a Qualified Candidate

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or related field (PhD preferred).
  • 10+ years of product management experience, including 5+ years leading AI/ML or advanced analytics products.
  • Deep technical expertise in AI/ML concepts, including LLMs, foundation models, supervised/unsupervised learning, fine-tuning, inference pipelines, and multi-modal AI.
  • Proven success embedding AI into enterprise-scale platforms, especially in data management, analytics, or cloud environments.
  • Strong technical fluency with AI infrastructure — including distributed training, inference optimization, GPU/accelerator integration, and workload orchestration.
  • Experience defining APIs, SDKs, and developer integrations for enterprise AI adoption.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of hybrid and multi-cloud architectures and their impact on AI performance, scalability, and cost optimization.
  • Familiarity with governance and compliance frameworks (HIPAA, GDPR, SOC2) and applying them to AI/ML solutions.
  • Exceptional communication skills with the ability to influence C-level stakeholders and articulate AI product strategy.
  • Track record of customer engagement, market analysis, and competitive benchmarking in enterprise software.

What You Will Bring

  • Expertise in optimizing AI workloads across cloud and hybrid environments, ensuring cost-efficiency and performance at scale.
  • Hands-on knowledge of GPU, TPU, and emerging accelerator technologies for training, inference, and fine-tuning AI models.
  • Ability to bridge AI model development with structured and unstructured enterprise data at petabyte scale.
  • A strong understanding of responsible AI, including fairness, explainability, auditability, and bias detection.
  • Vision to anticipate industry trends and position Teradata’s AI offerings as differentiated and enterprise-ready.
  • Passion for enabling intuitive, AI-powered user experiences (e. g. , natural language query, automated insights, intelligent automation).
  • Ability to operate as a senior leader — setting strategy, guiding technical direction, and influencing globally.

Why We Think You'll Love Teradata

We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are committed to actively working to foster an inclusive environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.

title: Director- Operations/ Product (Night Shift)
descriptionHtml:
About Amenify

Amenify is the leading AI-powered resident commerce platform in the US that helps property managers and residents with services they love. Through a proprietary network of local providers, enterprise integrations, and personalized concierge tools, Amenify powers services like local retail, dining, grocery, home services, maintenance, and more. Through its API integrations powering resident engagement, Amenify is available in 15 million homes in the USA. Amenify was founded in 2017 in San Francisco and has raised $25M to date. 


We encourage high-performers from all backgrounds to reach out, provided they share our core values listed here: https://www.amenify.com/about-us


About the Role

Amenify is seeking a strategic, execution-focused Director – Operations / Product to lead and scale our night-shift operations while partnering closely with leadership on product strategy, process automation, and operational excellence.

This role is ideal for a hands-on leader who can bridge day-to-day operational execution with long-term product thinking. You will be responsible for improving service quality, customer experience, provider performance, response times, and operational efficiency while translating frontline insights into product improvements.

You will work closely with customer support, operations, product, engineering, and leadership teams to identify bottlenecks, build scalable workflows, improve internal tools, and ensure the night operations team consistently delivers high-quality service.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, manage, and scale night-shift operations teams across multiple functions.
  • Ensure strong execution against key operational KPIs, including service quality, response time, fulfillment rate, issue resolution, customer satisfaction, provider performance, and SLA adherence.
  • Build scalable operational processes, workflows, playbooks, and escalation systems.
  • Drive continuous improvements in customer experience, provider experience, service reliability, and operational efficiency.
  • Develop dashboards, reporting mechanisms, and performance metrics to track operational health and team productivity.

title: Director, Platform Product Management
descriptionHtml:
FICO (NYSE: FICO) is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100+ countries make better decisions. Join our world-class team today and fulfill your career potential!

The Opportunity

We are seeking a strategic and technically grounded product leader to serve as Director of Platform Product Management – Infrastructure. This role will define and execute the product strategy for core infrastructure capabilities that power enterprise platforms and applications. The infrastructure platform serves both internal and external customers, enabling scalable, secure, and resilient systems.

What You’ll Contribute

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for infrastructure platform capabilities including compute, storage, networking, cloud services, and infrastructure automation.
  • Collaborate with infrastructure engineering, architecture, operations, and security teams to deliver solutions that meet performance, availability, scalability, and compliance requirements.
  • Drive initiatives that improve infrastructure availability, performance, cost efficiency, and defect reduction, with clear KPIs and continuous monitoring.
  • Champion observability and monitoring practices to ensure visibility into infrastructure health and performance.
  • Advocate for secure-by-design principles and ensure infrastructure services meet enterprise security and governance standards.
  • Partner with internal product and application teams to ensure infrastructure services are reliable, scalable, and aligned with evolving business needs.
  • Prioritize infrastructure investments based on business impact, risk, and technical feasibility.
  • Communicate product vision, strategy, and progress to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Stay ahead of industry trends in cloud infrastructure, automation, and platform engineering to inform strategy.


What We’re Seeking

  • 15+ years of industry experience in technology, with at least 10 years in product management roles.
  • Proven success in managing infrastructure platform products at scale.
  • Deep understanding of cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP), virtualization, containerization (Kubernetes, Docker), and networking.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible), observability platforms (e.g., Prometheus, Datadog), and security frameworks.
  • Strong analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence without direct authority.
  • Experience in financial services or other regulated industries highly desired.
  • Deep experience with compliance standards, data center operations, and hybrid cloud environments.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Bachelor/Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical field. MBA or equivalent business education.


Our Offer to You

  • An inclusive culture strongly reflecting our core values: Act Like an Owner, Delight Our Customers and Earn the Respect of Others.
  • The opportunity to make an impact and develop professionally by leveraging your unique strengths and participating in valuable learning experiences.
  • Highly competitive compensation, benefits and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognized for doing so.
  • An engaging, people-first work environment offering work/life balance, employee resource groups, and social events to promote interaction and camaraderie.


Why Make a Move to FICO?

At FICO, you can develop your career with a leading organization in one of the fastest-growing fields in technology today – Big Data analytics. You’ll play a part in our commitment to help businesses use data to improve every choice they make, using advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, optimization, and much more.

FICO makes a real difference in the way businesses operate worldwide:

  • Credit Scoring — FICO® Scores are used by 90 of the top 100 US lenders.
  • Fraud Detection and Security — 4 billion payment cards globally are protected by FICO fraud systems.
  • Lending — 3/4 of US mortgages are approved using the FICO Score.


Global trends toward digital transformation have created tremendous demand for FICO’s solutions, placing us among the world’s top 100 software companies by revenue. We help many of the world’s largest banks, insurers, retailers, telecommunications providers and other firms reach a new level of success. Our success is dependent on really talented people – just like you – who thrive on the collaboration and innovation that’s nurtured by a diverse and inclusive environment. We’ll provide the support you need, while ensuring you have the freedom to develop your skills and grow your career. Join FICO and help change the way business thinks!

Learn more about how you can fulfil your potential at www.fico.com/Careers

FICO promotes a culture of inclusion and seeks to attract a diverse set of candidates for each job opportunity. We are an equal employment opportunity employer and we’re proud to offer employment and advancement opportunities to all candidates without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. Research has shown that women and candidates from underrepresented communities may not apply for an opportunity if they don’t meet all stated qualifications. While our qualifications are clearly related to role success, each candidate’s profile is unique and strengths in certain skill and/or experience areas can be equally effective. If you believe you have many, but not necessarily all, of the stated qualifications we encourage you to apply.

Information submitted with your application is subject to the FICO Privacy policy at https://www.fico.com/en/privacy-policy

title: Head of Product
descriptionHtml:
The CoinDCX Journey: Building the Future of Finance:

At CoinDCX, our mission is clear - to make crypto and blockchain accessible to every Indian and enable them to participate in the future of finance.

As India’s first crypto unicorn valued at $2.45B, we are reshaping the financial ecosystem by building safe, transparent, and scalable products that power adoption at scale.

We believe that change starts together. It begins with bold ideas, relentless execution and people who want to build what’s next.

If you’re driven by purpose and thrive in environments where your work defines the next chapter of an industry, you’ll feel right at home here.

About the Role:

This isn’t a typical Head of Product role. The expectation is not just to optimize flows, but to fundamentally redefine how trading works for millions of users. You’ll step in at a critical inflection point, owning the next phase of growth for a platform already operating at scale. This role is about expanding into new product frontiers, unlocking new opportunities, and building category-defining trading experiences. It’s a high-impact mandate to drive innovation and shape the future of trading at scale.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead a Product Management team focused on conceiving, building, and launching user-focused, high-quality products that connect and grow the crypto economy.
  • Work closely with fellow engineering, design, and business leadership to define our product vision and strategy across your product areas, and deliver tangible business outcomes.
  • Identifying and defining KPIs and metrics for the team to set targets and drive overall team performance.
  • Hire, manage, and grow a team of Product Managers and help them to reach their potential.
  • Execute efficiently in a fast-paced, fluid start-up environment where change is constant and creativity is a must.
  • Driving a cross-functional team with engineering, design, support, and marketing to resolve end to end customer issues.

You’ll Excel in This Role If You:

  • Trading experience in the past, with a strong understanding of financial markets—especially Indian markets—and a genuine passion to build and scale products in this space
  • 14+ years of Product Management experience with 4+ years in scaling digital B2C products with customer first focus
  • A deep understanding and appreciation for good design and user experience
  • A track record of building exceptional products that delight your users and produce clear business impact
  • Demonstrated ability to lead projects affecting many functions, including product, engineering, finance, compliance, and support.
  • Ability to direct major cross-functional initiatives with effective prioritization and influence
  • Experience collecting both internal and external customer feedback and requests, empathizing with their challenges and opportunities, and prioritizing roadmaps to optimize results
  • Experience in A/B testing and in working with data analytics/data science teams to get metric driven analysis
  • Worked in an agile environment or on the scrum methodology
  • Passion for cryptocurrency, financial markets, and the CoinDCX mission
  • Worked in an agile environment or on the scrum methodology
  • Passion for cryptocurrency, financial markets, and the CoinDCX mission

Good to have :

  • Experience working in regulated industries collaborating with legal, compliance, and customer support teams
  • Experience in software development or a sound understanding of technical architecture

Hiring Process:

Here’s what your journey with us looks like:

  • Application Review – We assess for skills, alignment, and intent
  • Recruiter Connect – A short conversation to understand you better
  • Functional Round(s) – Deep dive into your approach, craft, and problem-solving
  • Assignment / Simulation Round – A take-home task or live problem-solving exercise to understand how you think and execute in real scenarios
  • Culture & Values Discussion – A conversation to understand our ways of working and how you thrive best
  • Founder Conversation (Optional) – For certain roles and senior levels, you may meet our founders to explore strategic alignment and long-term fit

Where We Work:

We believe the best ideas emerge when people build together. Collaboration, speed and trust come alive when teams share the same space.

With this belief, we operate as a work-from-office organisation. This role is based out of our Bengaluru office, where energy, alignment and innovation move in real time.

Perks That Empower You:

We believe great people deserve great experiences.

  • Design Your Own Benefits: Flexible perks to match your lifestyle
  • Unlimited Wellness Leaves: Rest and recharge as you need
  • Mental Wellness Support: Access to therapy and wellness resources
  • Learning Sessions: Bi-weekly learning and growth opportunities

Ready to Build What’s Next?

If you’re looking for a role that gives you direct access to high-stakes decisions, deep impact and a chance to build the future of finance, this is it.

Join CoinDCX and help us make crypto accessible to every Indian, together.

descriptionHtml:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Product

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

About Employee Service At Salesforce

Salesforce Employee Service powers next-generation internal support and service management. Our platform enables organizations to deliver seamless IT and HR experiences to their workforce by:

  • Automating internal service processes and streamlining cross-departmental workflows.
  • Leveraging AI to intelligently mine knowledge, resolve employee inquiries instantly, and power autonomous, agent-driven interactions.
  • Delivering exceptional employee experiences with intelligent case routing, predictive insights, and real-time collaboration tools that boost enterprise productivity.

About The Role

title: Senior Manager – New Product Development & Quality
descriptionHtml:
About Swiggy Instamart

Swiggy Instamart, is building the convenience grocery segment in India. We offer more than 40000 items to our customers within 10-15 mins. We are striving to augment our consumer promise of enabling unparalleled convenience by making grocery delivery instant and delightful. Instamart has been operating in 120+ cities across India and plan to expand to a few more soon. We have seen immense love from the customers till now and are excited to redefine how India shops

Job Description: Sr. Manager – New Product Development (NPD) & Quality

Role: Senior Manager - Subject Matter Expert for Munchies & Snacks, Traditional Foods, Sweets, Chocolates-Confectionary, Breakfast cereals & Emerging Categories

Role Objective

We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Manager – Product Development & Quality to lead end-to-end development and quality assurance across Snacking, Traditional Foods, Sweets, Breakfast Cereals, and Emerging Categories within our private label portfolio.

As the Sr. Manager – NPD & Quality, This role will serve as the technical backbone for product range expansion, transforming traditional flavors into scalable, high-quality offerings. This role bridges culinary expertise with food science, ensuring every product meets our highest standards of quality, safety, and consistency. Drive trend-led innovation while upholding world-class product quality and robust food safety standards across all categories.

Key Responsibilities

  • Product Development & Innovation

End-to-End Development: Lead the formulation of a diverse portfolio including Namkeen, Extruded Snacks, Energy Bars, and Confectionary.

Traditional Modernization: Adapt Indian Sweets, Chikki, and Traditional Foods for modern retail without losing authentic "homemade" soul.

Clean Label Initiative: Work to reduce artificial additives, moving toward natural preservatives in Chutneys and Spreads.

Health & Wellness: Drive innovation in Emerging Categories like high-protein Energy Bars, Clean-Label Spreads, and Whole-Grain Breakfast Cereals.

Develop and optimize recipes/formulations aligned to target cost, quality, and shelf-life

Drive innovation based on market trends, competitor benchmarking, and consumer insights

Conduct trials (lab & plant scale) and ensure successful commercialization

  • Quality Assurance & Standardization

Define product specifications, SOPs, and quality benchmarks for all SKUs

Establish sensory, physical, and microbiological quality parameters

Conduct supplier audits, product evaluations, and ensure batch-to-batch consistency

Implement quality improvement initiatives and root cause analysis for deviations

  • Supplier Management & Capability Building

Identify, Audit, onboard, and develop suppliers/vendors

Work closely with manufacturers to ensure adherence to product specs and process controls

Drive vendor performance through audits, scorecards, and continuous improvement plans

  • Regulatory & Compliance

Ensure compliance with FSSAI and other applicable food safety standards

Validate label claims, nutritional information, and ingredient declarations

Support regulatory documentation and approvals for new product launches

  • Cost Optimization & Productivity

Drive value engineering initiatives without compromising quality

Optimize formulations, ingredients, and processes to meet cost targets

Support scale-up efficiency and wastage reduction initiatives

  • Cross-functional Collaboration

Collaborate with Procurement, Supply Chain, Marketing, and Operations for seamless launches

Align with packaging and logistics teams for shelf-life and stability considerations

Support customer feedback analysis and continuous product improvement.

Key Skills & Competencies

Strategic Product Development: Ability to build and drive NPD pipeline across categories, translating consumer insights and traditional recipes into scalable, commercially viable products.

Food Science & Technical Expertise: Strong understanding of ingredients, processing technologies, shelf-life, and formulation across snacks, sweets, and cereals.

Quality & Food Safety Leadership: Deep knowledge of FSSAI, HACCP, GMP/GHP with the ability to establish robust quality systems and ensure compliance across vendors.

Scale-up & Commercialization: Proven capability in moving products from lab to plant scale, ensuring consistency, efficiency, and speed-to-market.

Supplier & Stakeholder Management: Strong experience in vendor development, audits, and cross-functional collaboration (Procurement, Ops, Marketing, Supply Chain).

Cost Optimization & Value Engineering: Ability to balance cost, quality, and performance through formulation and process optimization.

Analytical Thinking & Problem Solving: Strong root cause analysis, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement mindset.

Innovation & Market Orientation: Ability to identify trends, benchmark competition, and drive differentiated product offerings.

Leadership & Team Management: Capability to lead teams, influence stakeholders, and drive accountability across functions and partners.

Execution Excellence: High ownership with the ability to manage multiple projects, timelines, and priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Travel requirement

This role requires extensive travel (~20–30%) across multiple cities and supplier locations.

Travel will be primarily for product development trials, plant validations, supplier onboarding, audits, and quality alignment.

The candidate should be comfortable working closely with manufacturing partners on-site to drive faster commercialization and consistent quality execution.

Qualifications & Experience

B.Tech / M.Tech in Food Technology/ Food Science with 10 years in R&D/NPD and Quality Assurance within the FMCG or Food Retail sector.

Experience In FMCG, QSR, Or Private Label Business Preferred

Ability to balance "the best recipe" with "the best COGS" (Cost of Goods Sold).

"We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, colour, religion, sex, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by the law"

title: Head of Product - Bureau
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Experian unlocks the power of data to create opportunities for consumers, businesses and society. We gather and analyse data in ways others can't. We help individuals take financial control and access financial services, businesses make smarter decision and succeed, lenders lend more responsibly, and organisations prevent identity fraud and crime. For more than 125 years, we've helped consumers and clients prosper, and economies and communities flourish – and we're not done. Our 17,800 people in 45 countries believe the possibilities for you, and our world, are growing. We're investing in new technologies, experienced people and new ideas so we can help create a better tomorrow.

Job Description

What you need to have

  • 8-12 Years of experience in the financial services industry in a product role or business intelligence domain with strong understanding of lending business, payments in the digital team of a Bank, large NBFC or a Fintech.
  • Agile Product development and Data Analytics expertise
  • Experience in actively supporting sales teams achieve revenues and EBIT targets
  • Product Life-cycle experience
  • Preferably should have handled customer lifecycle for D2C & B2B business lines.
  • Experience of collaborative working with cross functional teams

What You’ll Be Accountable For

  • Ownership of overall Product Development and Management for all bureau, analytics and decision products and services.
  • Drive Product Revenue and EBIT targets along with Sales teams
  • Lead Business Case production in line with execution of the roadmap defining investment scale and return on Investment, Payback, etc.
  • Lead initiatives to analyse complex business problems and issues using data from internal and external sources.
  • Build the product roadmap defining short, medium and long-term views for the evolution of all products including addition of 3rd party data and services.
  • Build and Drive GTM activities in close collaboration with Sales and Marketing teams.
  • Build and anchor the Research, Insight and Thought Leadership publications. Manage the rendering platform for products like standard insights.
  • Manage the scoping and development of enhancements to existing products and solutions with the India/Regional technology teams.
  • Ensuring continuous upskilling of team members technical and communication skills.
  • Internal design consultation for Strategic Accounts, support pre-sales with additional technical and design insights and providing solutions to complex customer problem statements. Drive the scoping and delivery for projects based on client requirements.
  • Keeping self and team updated with new approaches and trends in statistical analysis and data visualisation.

How We Will Measure Your Success

  • New Products / Innovation Revenue
  • Establish Thought Leadership
  • Improving Product EBIT
  • Deliver product roadmap within agreed TAT
  • Deliver platform capacity to align with pipeline and revenue forecasts
  • Support achievement of Revenue Targets by:
  • Delivering the agreed Product roadmap
  • Producing documentation to assist GTM
  • Ensuring the timely availability of the products and solutions
  • Consulting with strategic deals in the Pre-sales phase to support deal closure

Qualifications

  • Strong understanding of the consumer and commercial lending ecosystem and its associated data
  • Ability to work with diverse data sets with an analytical bent of mind
  • Ability to ideate & innovate and strong execution capabilities along with working under tight timelines. Knowledge both of B2B & D2C will be an added advantage.
  • Product Management understanding including product development, commercial acumen and GTM knowledge
  • Demonstrated experience in consulting, solution development and selling
  • Excellent communication, written and presentation skills
  • Strong Program Management skills
  • Proven leadership, coaching and development capabilities
  • Team player, performance driven individual with excellent time-management skills
  • Used to working under tight time pressure, great sense of priority management
  • High level of communication and personal presence
  • Strong market knowledge of latest innovations in the data analytics space and its associated utilization in various industries

Additional Information

Role Location: Mumbai

Experian Careers - Creating a better tomorrow together

descriptionHtml:
About The Company

Wadhwani AI Global (WAIG) is a non-profit AI research and product organisation building AI for social impact across the Global South, outside India. We work with governments, multilateral institutions, foundations, and on-the-ground partners to deploy AI solutions in agriculture, health, and education at population scale. With deepening operations in Rwanda, Kenya, Ethiopia, and across the African continent, we are entering a new phase of growth — building product capability that matches the scale and ambition of our partnerships.

Requirements

Role Overview

The Head of Product will lead products across the organisation. descriptionHtml:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Product

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

About Employee Service At Salesforce

Salesforce Employee Service powers next-generation internal support and service management. Our platform enables organizations to deliver seamless IT and HR experiences to their workforce by:

  • Automating internal service processes and streamlining cross-departmental workflows.
  • Leveraging AI to intelligently mine knowledge, resolve employee inquiries instantly, and power autonomous, agent-driven interactions.
  • Delivering exceptional employee experiences with intelligent case routing, predictive insights, and real-time collaboration tools that boost enterprise productivity.

About The Role

We’re seeking a visionary Director of Product Management to lead our next-generation AI initiatives and drive the strategy of AI-first, collaboration-first, and platform-centric innovations across our Employee Service portfolio (spanning IT Service Management and HR Service Delivery). This role is critical to building enterprise-grade internal service solutions that empower employees, IT helpdesks, and HR teams at scale.

You will lead the charge in transitioning our employee service paradigm from reactive ticketing to proactive, autonomous workflows. You will build and scale enterprise-grade Agentic AI systems, determining how autonomous agents collaborate with human employees, integrating state-of-the-art LLMs, and defining the future of AI-first work.

As the owner of the AI roadmap, you will translate the latest industry trends—spanning Generative AI and Predictive Machine Learning—into scalable product features. Working cross-functionally with engineering, data science, UX, sales, and marketing, you will ensure our AI solutions remain cutting-edge, secure, and highly impactful for transforming how enterprises support their workforce.

What You’ll Do

  • Define Product Strategy: Own the product vision and strategy for AI-driven capabilities within Employee Service (IT and HR domains), ensuring alignment with broader business goals.
  • Agentic AI Leadership: Lead the conceptualization and delivery of Agentic AI workflows, enabling autonomous, task-oriented AI agents to resolve internal IT tickets and HR requests.
  • Architectural Strategy: Drive product and architectural decisions around LLM integration, RAG pipelines, and agent orchestration frameworks. You will own the trade-offs between model performance, latency, cost, and context window optimization.
  • AI Trust, Safety & Evals: Design robust evaluation frameworks for AI agents to measure accuracy, mitigate hallucinations, manage prompt injection risks, and maintain enterprise-grade data privacy.
  • AI-First UX: Define the UX paradigms for human-in-the-loop (HITL) interactions, ensuring seamless handoffs between autonomous agents and employees/IT Teams.
  • Customer Discovery & Integration: Engage directly with enterprise customers to understand complex pain points, specifically focusing on how they discover, adopt, and integrate AI applications into their internal IT, HR, and custom enterprise ecosystems (e.g., via API-based integrations and secure server environments).
  • Cross-Functional Execution: Collaborate deeply with engineering, data science, and UX teams to build scalable, intuitive, and high-performance AI solutions, driving prioritization and trade-offs.
  • Go-to-Market Alignment: Partner with sales, marketing, and enablement teams to define GTM strategies, positioning, and messaging to ensure successful product launches and market adoption.
  • Executive Communication: Regularly present product updates, AI strategies, and measurable results to C-suite leadership and external partners, ensuring continuous alignment.
  • Data-Driven Iteration: Leverage data-driven insights to continuously improve product offerings, tracking employee adoption, operational cost savings, and market share expansion.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: 14+ years of product management experience in enterprise SaaS, with a demonstrated track record of taking an Agentic product from 0-to-1 and scaling it in a production environment.
  • AI/ML Expertise: Hands-on familiarity with LLM orchestration (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex), embedding models, vector databases, and designing autonomous agent loops (planning, tool use, reflection). You deeply understand the trade-offs between different foundation models and fine-tuning vs. RAG approaches. Strong working knowledge of predictive ML models and data pipelines.
  • Technical Fluency: Experience with AI evaluation techniques (e.g., LLM-as-a-judge) and continuous model improvement cycles based on human feedback. Ability to engage deeply with engineering and data science teams on architectural tradeoffs, model selection, and performance metrics.
  • Strategic Execution: Proven track record of developing and executing comprehensive, multi-quarter product roadmaps that drive measurable business impact.
  • Communication Skills: Exceptional executive presence with the ability to navigate stakeholder alignment and articulate complex AI concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Preferred Domain Knowledge: A proven ability to build scalable AI/LLM products is essential. Familiarity with Salesforce AI capabilities (e.g., Salesforce Einstein, Agentforce, Data Cloud) and prior experience in IT Service Management (ITSM), HR Service Delivery, or Employee Workflows are highly preferred but not mandatory.

Why Join Us?

  • Work on cutting-edge AI-powered solutions that transform internal support experiences for enterprises.
  • Collaborate with a world-class team in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Shape the future of intelligent employee service management and drive meaningful impact by solving real organizational challenges at scale.
  • Be part of a culture of innovation, collaboration, personal growth and continuous learning.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.
