title: Director of Product
descriptionHtml:
Serko is a cutting-edge tech platform in global business travel & expense technology. When you join Serko, you become part of a team of passionate travellers and technologists bringing people together, using the world's leading business travel marketplace. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, we embrace the richness of diversity, showing up authentically to create a positive impact. There's an exciting road ahead of us, where travel needs real, impactful change.

With offices in New Zealand, Australia, North America, and China, we are thrilled to be expanding our global footprint, landing our growing and established hub in Bengaluru, India. With rapid a growth plan in place for India, we're hiring people from different backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives to help us build a world-class team and product.

As one of the Directors of Product at Serko, you will oversee the development of platform shared services that creates the foundation for all of our travel product offerings. You will be responsible for setting and executing the product strategy and roadmap for those services in close collaboration with the Director of Engineering, Platform. In addition, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver exceptional products that meet customer needs and drive business success downstream from the platform delivery. It is expected that you will deliver AI-native platform services that will fuel Serko's most modern agentic products - as such, you will be expected to align and collaborate with other Directors of Product who will rely on the platform to make their product experiences come to life. Successful candidates are expected to demonstrate high levels of technical acumen and have a demonstrated track record of building world-class technology platforms (or similar shared technology services).


Requirements

What you'll do

Platform Product Strategy and Roadmap:

  • Closely collaborating with key stakeholders including Directors of Engineering for Platform, and Directors of Product of Serko's travel Products
  • Translates business strategy and product requirements into scalable, reusable capabilities that evolve shared services into a strategic asset. 
  • Independently anticipates future needs to drive operational efficiency and company-wide innovation with critical inputs from Directors of Product of Serko's travel products
  • Sets clear goals, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives
  • Curates and sequences the platform roadmap by balancing validated travel product demands with strategic priorities
  • Manages trade-offs between resourcing and platform investment. 

AI Innovation:

  • Implements modern technologies into platform product designs to ensure Serko's products are at the forefront of technology solutions for customers, including AI-native experiences
  • Leverages data and insights to drive continuous improvement of product delivery for platform

Stakeholder Communication:

  • Collaborates with product, technology and commercial (Revenue) peers to ensure platform delivery is aligned to company delivery, customer expectations and customer success
  • Communicates effectively with stakeholders, including executives, customers, and partners, to ensure alignment, support for product initiatives and report progress of platform delivery
  • Presents platform product strategies, roadmaps and updates to senior leadership, influencing decisions with compelling data insights

End-to-End Product Management:

  • Delivers world-class platform products that fuel e-commerce experiences for the corporate travel industry, from customer-facing tools to supply-side aggregation and partnerships with 3rd party plugins
  • Oversees the entire platform product lifecycle from ideation to launch, ensuring timely delivery and high-quality standards, while quickly and effectively solving any faults
  • Drives an AI-first platform agenda, ensuring infrastructure is designed to natively support model-driven and agentic product experiences (real-time inference, orchestration, and scalable data pipelines) as a default, not an add-on
  • Raises the bar on velocity with precision, embedding experimentation, automated testing (including model validation), and continuous delivery practices that enable rapid, confident shipping of AI-powered features
  • Owns the evolution of infrastructure as a direct product enabler, delivering scalable, observable, and governed systems that accelerate AI product delivery while meeting enterprise standards for reliability, security, and trust
  • Acts as a bridge between strategic and tactical execution, knowing when to zoom out to empower teams and when to zoom in to remove blockers

Collaborative Development:

  • Partners with cross-functional teams to drive customer outcomes from discovery to launch
  • Collaborates with other product teams  to develop compelling value propositions that drive product adoption and revenue growth

Performance Metrics and Optimization:

  • Defines and tracks key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure platform product success, impact on business objectives, and product adoption
  • Uses data-driven insights to optimize performance and inform strategic decisions in the most effective products to achieve Serko's business objectives

Leadership and Mentorship:

  • Fosters a collaborative and innovative team culture that encourages data-driven decision-making, creativity and continuous improvement
  • Acts as a mentor for other Product Managers across the company to support their ongoing professional development
  • Models AI-native principles in platform delivery encouraging the use and application of AI in platform product delivery
  • Mentor more junior product management staff, even in situations where no direct reporting lines exist, to ensure a continuous learning opportunity for our people

What you'll bring to the team

  • Demonstrable experience in strategic product leadership, demonstrating success in both strategic planning and hands-on execution in a high-growth technology company building technology infrastructure and platforms
  • Ability to translate complex engineering constraints and architectural trade-offs into clear product decisions and to translate travel product requirements back into technically precise platform inputs
  • Deep understanding of product management principles, methodologies, and best practices, especially for high-velocity product development of technology platforms and infrastructure
  • Experience in designing, building and optimizing API-first platforms and shared infrastructure to support e-commerce products with consumer-grade experiences on modern technologies (including AI agentic products)
  • Hunger to learn new technologies and implement ever evolving technological advances into product design and development
  • Strong evidence of analytical and problem-solving skills with experience in data-driven decision making, experimentation in product development, utilisation of data and research to inform product strategies and optimize performance
  • Proven expertise in data-driven decision making that drives continuous improvement in product development
  • Strong commercial acumen  and data-driven approach to decision-making and building products that drive business growth
  • Ability to balance long-term strategy with shorter-term tactical execution, ensuring both high-level vision and operational effectiveness
  • Exceptional leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and align cross-functional teams as well as work collaboratively across disciplines in the business
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and facilitation skills, capable of conveying complex ideas, analytical results and complex business problems to diverse audiences
  • Strong adaptability and resilience, adept at navigating ambiguity, working in uncertainty and driving results in a fast-paced tech environment
  • Experience in the travel tech industry is preferred, or a demonstrated understanding of the unique challenges and opportunities in the business travel industry
  • Appetite to deeply understand the regulatory environment, the complex competitive landscape, and business trends of the evolving corporate travel industry

Benefits

At Serko we aim to create a place where people can come and do their best work.  This means you'll be operating in an environment with great tools and support to enable you to perform at the highest level of your abilities, producing high-quality, and delivering innovative and efficient results. Our people are fully engaged, continuously improving, and encouraged to make an impact.

  • Some of the benefits of working at Serko are:
  • A competitive base pay
  • Medical Benefits
  • Discretionary incentive plan based on individual and company performance
  • Focus on development: Access to a learning & development platform and opportunity for you to own your career pathways
  • Flexible work policy

Apply

Hit the ‘apply' button now, or explore more about what it's like to work at Serko and all our global opportunities at www.Serko.com .

- Collaborates with other product teams  to develop compelling value propositions that drive product adoption and revenue growth
Performance Metrics and Optimization:

- Defines and tracks key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure platform product success, impact on business objectives, and product adoption
- Uses data-driven insights to optimize performance and inform strategic decisions in the most effective products to achieve Serko's business objectives
Leadership and Mentorship:

- Fosters a collaborative and innovative team culture that encourages data-driven decision-making, creativity and continuous improvement
- Acts as a mentor for other Product Managers across the company to support their ongoing professional development
- Models AI-native principles in platform delivery encouraging the use and application of AI in platform product delivery
- Mentor more junior product management staff, even in situations where no direct reporting lines exist, to ensure a continuous learning opportunity for our people

What you'll bring to the team

- Demonstrable experience in strategic product leadership, demonstrating success in both strategic planning and hands-on execution in a high-growth technology company building technology infrastructure and platforms
- Ability to translate complex engineering constraints and architectural trade-offs into clear product decisions and to translate travel product requirements back into technically precise platform inputs
- Deep understanding of product management principles, methodologies, and best practices, especially for high-velocity product development of technology platforms and infrastructure

- Experience in designing, building and optimizing API-first platforms and shared infrastructure to support e-commerce products with consumer-grade experiences on modern technologies (including AI agentic products)
- Hunger to learn new technologies and implement ever evolving technological advances into product design and development

- Strong evidence of analytical and problem-solving skills with experience in data-driven decision making, experimentation in product development, utilisation of data and research to inform product strategies and optimize performance
- Proven expertise in data-driven decision making that drives continuous improvement in product development
- Strong commercial acumen  and data-driven approach to decision-making and building products that drive business growth
- Ability to balance long-term strategy with shorter-term tactical execution, ensuring both high-level vision and operational effectiveness
- Exceptional leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and align cross-functional teams as well as work collaboratively across disciplines in the business
- Excellent communication, presentation, and facilitation skills, capable of conveying complex ideas, analytical results and complex business problems to diverse audiences
- Strong adaptability and resilience, adept at navigating ambiguity, working in uncertainty and driving results in a fast-paced tech environment
- Experience in the travel tech industry is preferred, or a demonstrated understanding of the unique challenges and opportunities in the business travel industry
- Appetite to deeply understand the regulatory environment, the complex competitive landscape, and business trends of the evolving corporate travel industry

Benefits


At Serko we aim to create a place where people can come and do their best work.  This means you'll be operating in an environment with great tools and support to enable you to perform at the highest level of your abilities, producing high-quality, and delivering innovative and efficient results. Our people are fully engaged, continuously improving, and encouraged to make an impact.


- Some of the benefits of working at Serko are:
- A competitive base pay
- Medical Benefits
- Discretionary incentive plan based on individual and company performance
- Focus on development: Access to a learning & development platform and opportunity for you to own your career pathways
- Flexible work policy

Apply
Hit the ‘apply' button now, or explore more about what it's like to work at Serko and all our global opportunities at www.Serko.com .

title: AGM/DGM – Washing Machine R&D & Product Development
descriptionHtml:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced and dynamic leader to head the Research & Development and New Product Development function for our Washing Machine Division. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in development of Semi-Automatic, Fully Automatic Top Load, and Front Load Washing Machines with hands-on exposure in product engineering, platform development, localization, testing, compliance, and mass production readiness.

Key Responsibilities

·      Lead end-to-end development of SAWM, FATL, and FAFL washing machines.

·      Drive complete New Product Development lifecycle from concept to mass production.

·      Develop and improve motor systems, PCB & inverter systems, and mechanical systems.

·      Lead product reliability and validation activities including DFMEA / PFMEA.

·      Drive field quality improvements and warranty reduction initiatives.

·      Manage vendor development, tooling, localization, and cost optimization.

·      Ensure compliance with BIS, BEE, NABL, and export certifications.

·      Coordinate with Manufacturing, Quality, Purchase, Design, and Service teams.

·      Lead ODM/OEM customer projects and manage development timelines.

·      Build and mentor a high-performance R&D team.

Required Skills & Expertise

·      Washing machine architecture and systems engineering

·      BLDC / Inverter / Universal / Induction motor technologies

·      PCB and control systems understanding

·      Mechanical transmission systems and suspension systems

·      Noise & vibration reduction

·      Reliability engineering and testing

·      Cost engineering / Value engineering

·      DFMEA / PFMEA / SPC / 8D / 5 Why / Kaizen

·      CAD / 3D tools and FEA analysis tools (Ansys preferred)

·      Vendor development and tooling management

Preferred Candidate Profile

·      12–18 years experience in Washing Machine R&D / Product Development

·      Experience in appliance ODM/OEM projects

·      Exposure to Indian and export market requirements

·      Strong leadership and project management capability

·      Ability to work in a fast-paced manufacturing environment

What We Offer

·      Opportunity to build next-generation appliance platforms

·      Leadership role with high ownership

·      Fast-growing ODM manufacturing ecosystem

·      Exposure to national and global appliance programs

Education

·      B.Tech / B.E. in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechatronics, or related Engineering discipline

·      Master’s degree in Engineering / Management will be an added advantage

·      Strong technical foundation in Home Appliance Product Development preferred

title: Head of Product & Commercialisation (5+ Years Experience | Immediate Joiners only | Remote)
descriptionHtml:
About the Role

Our client is seeking a highly entrepreneurial and technically strong Head of Product & Commercialisation to lead an AI-enabled B2B SaaS platform in the ESG, Sustainability, and LegalTech space. The product is already live, funded, and solving emerging challenges across large digital platforms.

This is a founder-facing leadership role with end-to-end ownership of product strategy, technical product direction, commercialization, partnerships, and go-to-market execution. The successful candidate will play a key role in shaping product vision, driving adoption, and preparing the business for scale.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own and drive product strategy, roadmap, positioning, packaging, and commercialization.
  • Lead product innovation through customer discovery, market research, and feature ideation.
  • Define and execute go-to-market (GTM) strategies and product launches.
  • Work closely with engineering teams to define technical requirements, APIs, integrations, workflows, and scalable platform capabilities.
  • Translate customer and business needs into clear product requirements and execution plans.
  • Build relationships with ecosystem partners, agencies, and strategic stakeholders.
  • Leverage customer feedback, market insights, and product data to drive decision-making.
  • Support business growth, market expansion, and long-term scaling initiatives.


Required Skills

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience in B2B SaaS or Enterprise Software environments.
  • Proven experience building, launching, or scaling SaaS platforms or technology products.
  • Strong Technical Product Management experience, including APIs, integrations, workflows, platform products, and data-driven solutions.
  • Experience owning product strategy, roadmap planning, prioritization, and product lifecycle management.
  • Experience with product launches, GTM strategy, commercialization, and market adoption.
  • Mandatory ESG and Sustainability domain experience.
  • Proven experience working with ESG reporting, Sustainability platforms, ESG ratings, Governance frameworks, Compliance solutions, or related ESG-focused products.
  • Strong customer discovery, stakeholder management, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work directly with founders and thrive in high-growth, fast-paced, and ambiguous environments.


Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with AI, Generative AI, Agentic AI, or intelligent workflow platforms.
  • Experience with LegalTech, RegTech, ComplianceTech, Governance, Risk, or regulatory platforms.
  • Experience with marketplace, ecosystem, platform, or merchant-facing products.
  • Background in product marketing, pricing strategy, partnerships, or international product launches.


Why Consider This Opportunity

  • Founder-level ownership and influence.
  • Product already live and funded — not an idea-stage startup.
  • Opportunity to build and scale an AI-powered ESG & Sustainability SaaS platform.
  • Small, focused team with significant growth potential.
  • Direct impact on product direction, commercialization, and company growth.

YMinds.AI is a specialist talent partner helping startups and high-growth companies hire exceptional talent across Product, Engineering, AI, Data, and Digital functions.

title: Product Director - Branch Operations Product
descriptionHtml:
Job Description

Ignite your passion for product innovation by leading banker-centric development, inspiring solutions, and shaping the future with your strategic vision and influence.

As a Product Director in the Branch Operations Product team, you are at the forefront of revolutionizing banker interactions. Our team is tasked with simplifying existing banker tools and introducing new banker tools to create a seamless experience for bankers and customers. You will lead innovation through the development of products and features that not only delight our bankers and customers but also empower our branch teams.

In addition, this role will be responsible for managing all Executive budget related deliverables and controls across the Branch Operations Product, including but not limited to the Quarterly Investment Process, creating and monitoring self-inspection processes, managing access administration for the field and leading internal Audits within our space. Extensive technical, business and leadership experience is required to lead within the complex branch space. This position is ideal for an individual experienced in both Product and Program Management with excellent people management skills, strong organizational skills, an innovative mindset, risk and controls experience as well as strong analytical skills. Flexibility and comfort with ambiguity, given the rapid pace of change is required.

Job Responsibilities

  • Oversee the product roadmap, vision, development, execution, risk management, and business growth targets.
  • Lead the entire product life cycle through planning, execution, and future development by continuously adapting, developing new products and methodologies, managing risks, and achieving business targets such as cost efficiency, feature enhancements, reusability, and reliability.
  • Coach and mentor the product team on best practices, including solution discovery, market research, storyboarding, mind-mapping, prototyping methods, product adoption strategies, and product delivery, to ensure successful implementation of objectives.
  • Own product performance and make strategic investments in enhancements that align with overall business objectives.
  • Partner closely with Risk, Controls, Area Product Owners, Branch Channel and the field to understand needs of the business for requirements
  • Establish strong working relationships with business stakeholders, Technology, Operations, peers, subject matter experts and other partners
  • Act as a thought leader to drive problem solving and identify business solutions

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • 8+ years of experience or equivalent expertise in delivering products, projects, or technology applications.
  • Extensive knowledge of the product development life cycle, technical design, data analytics, and public cloud data storage solutions.
  • Proven history of building products that leverage public cloud data storage solutions.
  • General understanding of generative AI infrastructure and solutions.
  • Proven ability to drive change and influence the adoption of key product life cycle activities including discovery, ideation, strategic development, requirements definition, and value management.
  • Experience driving change within organizations and managing stakeholders across multiple functions.

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Experience in Retail Branch/Consumer Banking, Controls, Risk Management, or other related experience
  • AWS knowledge or experience in driving modernization on Public cloud
  • Recognized thought leader within a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience collaborating with both internal and external stakeholders to develop innovative product solutions.

About Us

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

About The Team

Our Consumer & Community Banking division serves our Chase customers through a range of financial services, including personal banking, credit cards, mortgages, auto financing, investment advice, small business loans and payment processing. We're proud to lead the U.S. in credit card sales and deposit growth and have the most-used digital solutions – all while ranking first in customer satisfaction.

title: Director-Digital Product Management
descriptionHtml:
Job Description

About GMNS Product Team

As part of the Global Merchant & Network Services group (GMNS), the GMNS Product team is at the core of American Express, uniquely positioned to support every business unit and customer across the Enterprise. The American Express Network enables over $1.6 trillion in annual spend, serving our Issuers and Acquirers in more than 170 markets worldwide.

We are driving a strategic, multi-year Enterprise Payments program to bring all payments together into a centre of excellence to drive operational excellence for payment execution, enable innovative payment products, services, and capabilities to be built effectively and efficiently, support our BU strategies more closely, and deliver on our customers’ evolving payment needs.

About The Role

The Director Enterprise Payments Product Development is an exciting role, responsible for building modern, scalable enterprise payment capabilities and ensuring high quality predictable delivery across global markets. This role sits within the Enterprise Payments Centre of Excellence and partners closely with Product Management Architecture Engineering Operations and Market teams to translate product strategy into robust technical capabilities and platform solutions.

This leader will be accountable for shaping how Enterprise Payments capabilities are designed, built, and delivered, while driving modernization of legacy payment flows and scaling bank based money movement solutions globally and transforming how payment platforms are developed at American Express.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and grow a high performing product development organization responsible for delivering enterprise grade payment capabilities across Bill Payments, Money Movement, Multi-Rail initiatives
  • Translate enterprise and product management strategies into clear capability roadmaps, technical delivery plans and executable backlogs aligned to priorities
  • Lead discovery and technical solutioning for new payment flows, bank integrations and money movement capabilities supporting critical customer and business journeys
  • Own Product delivery outcomes for Enterprise Payments products including quality reliability scalability and time to market across global releases
  • Define and refine capabilities features user stories and acceptance criteria ensuring solutions meet functional regulatory operational and market needs
  • Balance global platform standardization with market specific requirements ensuring scalable solutions while meeting regulatory and local banking needs
  • Drive modernization of payment capabilities including migration from legacy solutions to resilient scalable and cloud enabled platforms where applicable
  • Establish and monitor delivery and performance metrics to improve predictability throughput quality and incremental value delivery
  • Champion modern product development and delivery practices including agile ways of working iterative value delivery and strong collaboration across teams

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of leadership experience leading Product Development, Product Management, Platform Engineering or a similar role.
  • Deep interest in payments and financial technology with experience or exposure to Bill Pay, A2A payments, ACH, RTP, wires or bank integrations strongly preferred
  • Proven experience building and leading high performing teams across multiple locations and working effectively in a global enterprise environment
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver enterprise platforms or shared services that support multiple business units and markets
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills with the ability to navigate ambiguity make trade-offs and drive execution at scale
  • Ability to influence and partner effectively with senior leaders across Product Management Technology Operations and Business teams
  • Experience driving modernization initiatives and adopting new ways of working including scaled agile delivery models
  • Bachelor’s or Masters’ Degree in Engineering, Product, Business or related field.

About Us

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

About The Team

We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:

  • Competitive base salaries
  • Bonus incentives
  • Support for financial-well-being and retirement
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
  • Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
  • Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
  • Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
  • Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
  • Career development and training opportunities

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.

Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

Responsibilities



-  Lead and grow a high performing product development organization responsible for delivering enterprise grade payment capabilities across Bill Payments, Money Movement, Multi-Rail initiatives 
-  Translate enterprise and product management strategies into clear capability roadmaps, technical delivery plans and executable backlogs aligned to priorities 
-  Lead discovery and technical solutioning for new payment flows, bank integrations and money movement capabilities supporting critical customer and business journeys 
-  Own Product delivery outcomes for Enterprise Payments products including quality reliability scalability and time to market across global releases 
-  Define and refine capabilities features user stories and acceptance criteria ensuring solutions meet functional regulatory operational and market needs 
-  Balance global platform standardization with market specific requirements ensuring scalable solutions while meeting regulatory and local banking needs 
-  Drive modernization of payment capabilities including migration from legacy solutions to resilient scalable and cloud enabled platforms where applicable 
-  Establish and monitor delivery and performance metrics to improve predictability throughput quality and incremental value delivery 
-  Champion modern product development and delivery practices including agile ways of working iterative value delivery and strong collaboration across teams 

Qualifications



-  8+ years of leadership experience leading Product Development, Product Management, Platform Engineering or a similar role. 
-  Deep interest in payments and financial technology with experience or exposure to Bill Pay, A2A payments, ACH, RTP, wires or bank integrations strongly preferred 
-  Proven experience building and leading high performing teams across multiple locations and working effectively in a global enterprise environment 
-  Demonstrated ability to deliver enterprise platforms or shared services that support multiple business units and markets 
-  Strong analytical and problem solving skills with the ability to navigate ambiguity make trade-offs and drive execution at scale 
-  Ability to influence and partner effectively with senior leaders across Product Management Technology Operations and Business teams 
-  Experience driving modernization initiatives and adopting new ways of working including scaled agile delivery models 
-  Bachelor’s or Masters’ Degree in Engineering, Product, Business or related field. 

About Us

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

About The Team

We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:



- Competitive base salaries
- Bonus incentives
- Support for financial-well-being and retirement
- Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
- Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
- Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
- Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
- Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
- Career development and training opportunities

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.

Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

title: Product Management Head – Client Business
descriptionHtml:
Role: PM Head – Clients Business

Location – Bangalore


Key Responsibilities:

P&L & Strategic Management:

· Category Ownership - Own the sales targets and full P&L responsibility for the Windows, Chromebook, and Thin Client business units.

· Strategy Execution - Define and execute product strategies to increase market share and profitability across diverse client computing hardware.

· Market Analysis - Monitor trends in the PC market, competitive moves from OEMs (HP, Dell, Lenovo), and evolving customer needs to refine business strategies.


Sales Enablement & GTM

· Joint Planning – Create GTM plans with sales leadership for market coverage and optimized offering mixes.

· Enablement - Develop initiatives to support regional sales teams, focusing on the unique value propositions of Windows and ChromeOS ecosystems.

· KPI Management - Define success metrics and KPIs for the product team to ensure data-driven decision-making.


Desired Profile

· Leadership Experience - Proven background in product management or business leadership, specifically within End-User Computing or Enterprise IT Infrastructure.

· Industry Expertise - Strong understanding of the Windows and ChromeOS landscape, including hardware life cycles and thin client deployments.

· Soft Skills - Excellent negotiation, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to lead change in a fast-paced environment.

· Analytical Rigor - Strong strategic thinking abilities and the capacity to manage multiple stakeholders while driving double-digit business growth


OEM Relationship Management

The PM Head is responsible for managing a multi-OEM portfolio, requiring a balanced approach to ensure Ample remains a preferred partner across competing brands.

· Strategic Alliance Development - Build and maintain high-level relationships with regional and national leads at Dell, HP, and Lenovo to secure "Preferred Partner" status and top-tier rebates.

· Ecosystem Integration - Manage the tripartite relationship between Hardware OEMs (e.g., HP), OS providers (Microsoft/Google), and Chipset manufacturers (Intel/AMD) to drive "Whole-Product" solutions.

· Joint Business Planning : Lead QBRs with OEMs to align on volume commitments, specialized pricing, and MDF.

· Conflict Resolution: Act as the primary escalation point for deal registration conflicts or supply chain bottlenecks across the various client lines.


Leadership & Stakeholder Mapping

The PM Head acts as the central node connecting internal execution with external partner goals.

· Internal Mapping – Mapping various stakeholders such as Sales Leadership on Market coverage, GTM. RPM on Monitoring and driving regional execution of strategy, growth & OEM engagement. Logistics & Finance – Ensuring we deliver on time and plan the inventory| Review category profitability & Rebate attainment.

· OEM, Distributor & Partner Leadership Mapping.

· Team Mentorship - Lead and manage a team of Regional Product Managers, fostering a culture of data-driven decision-making and result-oriented performance.

title: Product Head- Fintech Portfolio Company
descriptionHtml:
Head of Product | B2B Fintech | Series A Bengaluru · Full-time

one of the fastest-growing B2B fintech platforms in an emerging market — profitable since day one, growing 6–9x year-on-year, and backed by some of the most respected names in global venture and operator investing. We are looking for a Head of Product to own our core expense management product and work directly alongside our Co-Founder & CPO.

The role

This is not a coordination role. You will own the expense management product end-to-end — what gets built, why, and in what order — and be accountable for outcomes. You will work in close partnership with our Co-Founder (engineering and product background, McKinsey Digital, deeply technical) and the Bengaluru engineering team.

What you will own:

  • Full product ownership of our core spend management product — corporate cards, spend controls, real-time visibility, and the workflows our customers rely on daily
  • The AI automation layer — receipt matching, reconciliation, document extraction, and defining what the next generation of finance automation looks like in production
  • Roadmap prioritisation grounded in deep customer understanding across 2,000+ business customers
  • Close day-to-day partnership with engineering — making tradeoffs with full technical context, not handing over specs

What we are looking for

  • 10-12+ years in product, with meaningful B2B experience — fintech, payments, or enterprise SaaS preferred
  • Technical credibility — comfortable going deep with engineers on architecture and systems decisions
  • AI-native product thinking — you treat AI as infrastructure, not a feature, and know how to embed it into workflows users rely on without noticing
  • Startup orientation — you apply rigour where it matters and move fast everywhere else
  • Someone who wants to build alongside a founder with strong opinions and will push back with equally strong ones

title: Head of Product & Growth Tech
descriptionHtml:
We're partnering with a premium consumer and hospitality company that has built a family of much-loved brands across dining, retail, and experiences. Over the last decade they have earned something rare: people came for the food, and stayed for the feeling.


As the business enters its next phase, they are looking for a senior leader to build the layer that deepens that relationship. Someone who can bring together customer data, CRM, loyalty, community, and AI, not as a set of systems, but as a way to make guests feel known, looked after, and genuinely closer to the brand.

This role reports directly to the founders. The operational foundation, the systems that run the business day to day, is already in place, held by a strong internal team. Your job is to build the growth and experience layer on top of it: the part that turns affection into a lasting, connected relationship across every brand.


What You'll Do

  • Define and drive the company's guest data, CRM, loyalty, and engagement strategy, with a view of loyalty that is about trust and belonging, not just points
  • Build a single, connected view of the guest across brands, channels, and touchpoints, without ever making the experience feel cold or transactional
  • Partner with marketing, CX, content, and business teams to deepen customer journeys, retention, and community
  • Use AI, automation, and technology thoughtfully, where it genuinely improves marketing, retention, service, and decision-making, never for its own sake
  •  Evaluate and bring in the right tools, platforms, and partnerships to support long-term growth, building on the foundation already in place
  • Sit with the founders on the bigger questions: what loyalty and community really mean for a hospitality brand, and how technology can amplify hospitality rather than replace it


What We're Looking For

  • 6 to 12 years across Product, CRM, Customer Experience, Loyalty, Growth, Martech, or Customer Data
  • A track record of building engagement, retention, loyalty, or personalisation initiatives at real scale
  • Strong grasp of CRM ecosystems, customer data, and lifecycle marketing, and the ability to turn data into relationships, not just campaigns
  • Comfortable combining strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and working through an existing team rather than around it
  • Experience in consumer-facing businesses: retail, hospitality, food, D2C, lifestyle, or technology platforms
  • Hands-on experience with AI-driven customer experience or growth is a plus, not a requirement
  •  Most of all: you think of customers as guests, not data points, and you care about how a brand makes people feel. That instinct matters here more than any single tool on your CV.


Why Consider This Role?

  •  A direct partnership with the founders, on something they care about deeply
  • The chance to define a brand-new capability, on top of a foundation that is already built, so you are creating, not firefighting
  • Real influence over guest experience, loyalty, community, and growth across multiple brands
  •  A rare brief: use technology to make a beloved hospitality company more connected and more loved, without losing the warmth that built it


How to Apply

Apply via LinkedIn or write to work@allthingstalent.in

title: Bogie Product Director
descriptionHtml:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

Could you be the full-time Bogie Product Director in Bangalore we’re looking for?

Your future role

Take on a new challenge and apply your strategic vision and leadership expertise in a new cutting-edge field. You’ll work alongside dynamic and collaborative teammates.

You'll play a pivotal role in driving innovation, ensuring the development and delivery of high-performing, cost-effective, and competitive bogie products that align with Alstom's mission for smarter and greener mobility. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (engineering, industrial, procurement, tender and costing), lead product roadmaps, and ensure the successful execution of programs, and much more.

You’ll specifically take care of coordinating product strategies and roadmaps, as well as ensuring product readiness for tenders and projects, but also fostering collaboration across teams to achieve quality, cost, and delivery targets.

We’ll look to you for:

  • Representing the RSC Platform on-site and ensuring innovation, development, tendering, launch, and sustainability for assigned technologies and products
  • Overseeing product portfolio management and ensuring alignment with the RS platform
  • Leading product roadmap activities, including development, procurement, and industrial strategy
  • Delivering QCD (Quality, Cost, Delivery) targets for programs
  • Managing product validation and homologation processes to meet market regulations
  • Driving product competitiveness through continuous improvement and Return of Experience (REX)

All About You

We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:

  • Master’s degree in a technical or equivalent field
  • 10+ years of experience in product management
  • Knowledge of product business and industrial environments
  • Experience in transversal and/or international leadership roles
  • Fluency in both English and French
  • Strategic vision and ability to benchmark competition
  • Strong management and organizational skills within a matrix environment
  • Excellent communication skills and team-oriented mindset
  • Proactive problem-solving and decision-making abilities
  • Knowledge of the railway industry

Things you’ll enjoy Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:

  • Enjoy stability, challenges and a long-term career free from boring daily routines
  • Work with new security standards for rail signalling
  • Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues
  • Contribute to innovative projects
  • Utilise our inclusive and flexible working environment
  • Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries
  • Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning
  • Progress towards senior leadership opportunities
  • Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension)

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

Important to note

As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

Important to note

As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

title: Director-Digital Product Management
descriptionHtml:
Job Description

About GMNS Product Team

As part of the Global Merchant & Network Services group (GMNS), the GMNS Product team is at the core of American Express, uniquely positioned to support every business unit and customer across the Enterprise. The American Express Network enables over $1.6 trillion in annual spend, serving our Issuers and Acquirers in more than 170 markets worldwide.

We are driving a strategic, multi-year Enterprise Payments program to bring all payments together into a centre of excellence to drive operational excellence for payment execution, enable innovative payment products, services, and capabilities to be built effectively and efficiently, support our BU strategies more closely, and deliver on our customers’ evolving payment needs.

About The Role

The Director Enterprise Payments Product Development is an exciting role, responsible for building modern, scalable enterprise payment capabilities and ensuring high quality predictable delivery across global markets. This role sits within the Enterprise Payments Centre of Excellence and partners closely with Product Management Architecture Engineering Operations and Market teams to translate product strategy into robust technical capabilities and platform solutions.

This leader will be accountable for shaping how Enterprise Payments capabilities are designed, built, and delivered, while driving modernization of legacy payment flows and scaling bank based money movement solutions globally and transforming how payment platforms are developed at American Express.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and grow a high performing product development organization responsible for delivering enterprise grade payment capabilities across Bill Payments, Money Movement, Multi-Rail initiatives
  • Translate enterprise and product management strategies into clear capability roadmaps, technical delivery plans and executable backlogs aligned to priorities
  • Lead discovery and technical solutioning for new payment flows, bank integrations and money movement capabilities supporting critical customer and business journeys
  • Own Product delivery outcomes for Enterprise Payments products including quality reliability scalability and time to market across global releases
  • Define and refine capabilities features user stories and acceptance criteria ensuring solutions meet functional regulatory operational and market needs
  • Balance global platform standardization with market specific requirements ensuring scalable solutions while meeting regulatory and local banking needs
  • Drive modernization of payment capabilities including migration from legacy solutions to resilient scalable and cloud enabled platforms where applicable
  • Establish and monitor delivery and performance metrics to improve predictability throughput quality and incremental value delivery
  • Champion modern product development and delivery practices including agile ways of working iterative value delivery and strong collaboration across teams

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of leadership experience leading Product Development, Product Management, Platform Engineering or a similar role.
  • Deep interest in payments and financial technology with experience or exposure to Bill Pay, A2A payments, ACH, RTP, wires or bank integrations strongly preferred
  • Proven experience building and leading high performing teams across multiple locations and working effectively in a global enterprise environment
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver enterprise platforms or shared services that support multiple business units and markets
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills with the ability to navigate ambiguity make trade-offs and drive execution at scale
  • Ability to influence and partner effectively with senior leaders across Product Management Technology Operations and Business teams
  • Experience driving modernization initiatives and adopting new ways of working including scaled agile delivery models
  • Bachelor’s or Masters’ Degree in Engineering, Product, Business or related field.

About Us

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

About The Team

We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:

  • Competitive base salaries
  • Bonus incentives
  • Support for financial-well-being and retirement
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
  • Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
  • Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
  • Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
  • Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
  • Career development and training opportunities

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.

Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

title: Head - Application & Product Development
descriptionHtml:
Job Purpose

Establish a fully developed Research & Development Centre targeting to Applied research for Chlor-Alkali products to bring in improvement /value addition to existing Products /Processes and develop a range of products, applications and product variants to suit requirements for Industrial/ water treatment/ Plastic and allied sector aligned to business objective.

Build strong technical competence in resolving customer problems, testing, analysis for Chlor-Alkali products with support for required certification of products.

Key Result Areas

KRA Supporting Actions

KRA1 Establishment Research centre & execution of research: Identification and execution of long term projects & goals for R&D Centre 1.Identify new segments and markets that require new products and work in collaboration with marketing to develop new products and applications

  • Estabilishment of Plasticizer Centre
  • Chart out the mandate for the Application Development Center
  • Prepare and pursue Annual P&B for R & D Centre and seek necessary budget approvals
  • Preparation of monthly MIS dashboards and deck presentation in reviews. (Meeting with BH, SBU Head & CMO)
  • Selection of skilled technical resources at R&D Centre

KRA2 New Product & Application development: Develop applications/ new product development and formulations 1.Understand and analyze the existing market trends, in-house competencies and propose development.

  • Ensure field testing of products to map them to the range of applications.
  • Work closely with Supply chain in optimizing and standardizing raw materials and testing procedures

KRA3 Recognition, accreditation, collaboration & certification: Identify and collaborate with various bodies for recognitions, accreditations as well collaborate with institutes for research projects and product Certification 1.Coordinate with Government agencies to complete the requisites and file necessary applications.

  • Identify and collaborate with recognized institutes/ organization to collaborate on the research projects.
  • Identification of required certification and ensuring requirement for existing ceritficates for all the products for DCA
  • Supporting the Units for annual audits and ensuring closure of NCs

KRA4 Product Improvement: Ensure product consistency and improvement by pilot trials.

Monitor, audit and control all testing procedures and set benchmark for product standards. 1.Extend support to the manufacturing team for improvement in existing products and processes.

  • Set up pilot tests, quality plans, procedures, documentations and report
  • Assist marketing in developing product data sheets, brochures, and other supporting documents

KRA5 Process Improvement: Ensure process reliability by pilot trials.

Monitor, audit and control all testing procedures and set benchmark for process standards. 1.Extend support to the manufacturing team for improvement in existing processes.

  • Set up pilot tests, quality plans, procedures, documentations and report

KRA6 People development & management: Managing and motivating team and ensure team has relevant skill set and abilities to perform. 1.Have clear goals & review mechanism for all the team members.

  • Formulate training plans for the Team.
  • Provide regular guidance, motivation & clear directions to team members.

KRA7 Technical support to customers & sales team: Responsible for building expertise and capabilities and support customers and internal team on technical front. 1.Build knowledge pool at Center by evaluating raw material, products and applications.

  • Regular trainings on NPD/ Application/ trends for internal team and dealers / customers
  • Closely work with customers to identify issues and accordingly work out solutions
  • Organize pilot and plant scale trails at customer site
  • Management of customer complaints, Inmrovement and communication to management

KRA8 Communication & IPR: Publishing/ presenting research work in national/ Intrernational Journal/ Conferences and patenting the IPR/ novelty work 1.Attend seminars and exhibitions to make presentations research findings.

  • Ensure publication and patenting of research findings

KRA9 Safety & policies: Ensuring Safety practices and implementation of policies 1.Ensuring safety practices in the laboratory at all levels including metrological conditions

  • Ensure implementation of all the HR processes and policies

title: Head of AI Full Stack Engineering - Global Software Product Company (Fully Remote)
descriptionHtml:
We are hiring a Head of AI Full Stack Engineering for a global enterprise software company. This is a hands-on technology leadership role for an exceptional engineer who can architect, build, and scale modern AI-native applications while leading engineering excellence across the organization.

Unlike traditional architecture or management positions, this role requires active involvement in software development, system design, AI implementation, and engineering execution. You will work across the entire technology stack—from frontend experiences and backend services to cloud infrastructure, data platforms, AI systems, and autonomous agent frameworks. You will help shape the future of AI-powered software engineering by combining deep technical expertise with strong leadership and execution capabilities.

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead the design, development, and evolution of enterprise-grade AI-powered products and platforms.
  • Architect and build scalable full-stack applications using modern frontend, backend, cloud, and AI technologies.
  • Drive the adoption of AI-native software development practices across engineering teams.
  • Design and implement LLM-powered applications, AI workflows, agentic systems, copilots, and intelligent automation solutions.
  • Define technical standards, architecture principles, coding guidelines, and engineering best practices.
  • Participate directly in software development, code reviews, architecture reviews, debugging, and technical problem-solving.
  • Build and optimize distributed systems, APIs, microservices, data pipelines, and cloud-native platforms.
  • Establish high standards for code quality, automated testing, CI/CD, security, observability, and operational excellence.
  • Evaluate emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and tools, translating them into practical business and engineering outcomes.
  • Mentor senior engineers and technical leads while fostering a culture of ownership, innovation, and continuous learning.
  • Partner closely with product, design, and business stakeholders to translate complex requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Drive engineering productivity through intelligent automation, AI-assisted development, and modern developer experience initiatives.
Qualifications
  • 12–20+ years of software engineering experience with significant experience in full-stack architecture and technical leadership.
  • Proven track record of building and scaling complex enterprise software products.
  • Deep hands-on expertise in TypeScript, Node.js, .NET, React, modern web architectures, APIs, and distributed systems.
  • Strong experience designing and developing cloud-native applications on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Practical experience building AI-powered applications using LLMs, RAG architectures, vector databases, AI agents, MCP, orchestration frameworks, or related technologies.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture patterns, system design, scalability, security, and performance engineering.
  • Experience leading engineering teams while remaining actively involved in coding and technical delivery.
  • Demonstrated ability to modernize legacy applications and build next-generation platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, automated testing, and platform engineering.
  • Excellent communication, technical leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Passion for leveraging AI to fundamentally improve how software is designed, developed, tested, and delivered.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience building agentic AI platforms, autonomous workflows, AI copilots, or developer productivity solutions.
  • Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP), AI tool orchestration, and agent frameworks.
  • Background in enterprise SaaS, platform engineering, or large-scale B2B software products.
  • Experience working with globally distributed engineering teams.
  • Open-source contributions, technical thought leadership, or AI product development experience.
Important Notice

This is a highly hands-on engineering leadership role. We are looking for immediate joiners or candidates who can join within a maximum of 2 weeks. Please apply only if you meet this availability requirement. Candidates with longer notice periods will not be considered.

title: Product Management - Digital Transformation - Vice President
descriptionHtml:
Job Description

Are you looking for an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic and growing team in a fast paced and challenging area? This is a unique opportunity for you to work in the Product Management team to partner with the Business.

As a Vice President of Product Management in wholesale lending services team, you will lead the strategy and delivery of digital solutions that transform our wholesale lending business.

Job Responsibilities

  • Own and evolve product vision, multi-year strategy, and roadmap, aligning to business priorities, regulatory/controls requirements, and customer outcomes.
  • Lead people management: hire, coach, develop, and performance-manage product talent; set operating cadence, standards, and career growth plans.
  • Establish and run program governance (operating model, decision forums, intake/prioritization, dependency management, risk/issue management, and execution reporting).
  • Provide data insights for leadership: define KPI frameworks/OKRs, build executive-level dashboards, translate metrics into narrative, and drive decisions with evidence.
  • Direct solution discovery with cross-functional partners (engineering, design, data, operations, controls) to identify scalable solutions and validate value.
  • Lead product planning and delivery across portfolios/releases—ensuring scope clarity, sequencing, and timely launches with measurable benefits.
  • Partner with business stakeholders and controls to define target-state workflows, requirements, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and customer value.
  • Apply Agile-at-scale practices to improve throughput and predictability; remove impediments and manage trade-offs across competing priorities.
  • Drive change management and end-user adoption: stakeholder mapping, comms/training plans, enablement materials, feedback loops, and adoption measurement.
  • Ensure quality and readiness through test management and automation, production verification, and post-release monitoring; drive continuous improvement via root-cause analysis.
  • Collaborate closely with engineering to ensure secure, resilient delivery and alignment to architecture, data, and platform standards.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, IT, or related field
  • Demonstrated leadership as a VP/Senior Product Manager/Product Lead delivering digital transformation in financial services (wholesale lending).
  • Strong understanding of wholesale lending processes, digital technologies, and risk/controls considerations in regulated environments.
  • Proven people leadership experience (managing PM/PO teams), including coaching, operating cadence, and talent development.
  • Strong change management capability to drive adoption and measure behavior change/outcomes.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, stakeholder management, organization, and presentation skills.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office and Agile tooling (e.g., Jira/Confluence or equivalent).

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Expertise across the product lifecycle: discovery → delivery → launch → adoption → optimization.
  • Strong data literacy: KPI/OKR design, dashboarding, insight generation, and executive storytelling to influence decisions.
  • Experience leading program governance and cross-functional execution across multiple workstreams and dependencies.

About Us

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

About The Team

J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

descriptionHtml:
Our Company

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

What You’ll Do

In this role, you will serve as a senior Products leader driving Teradata’s AI product management strategy across our global portfolio. You will define and influence how Teradata integrates AI/ML technologies into our enterprise-scale data and analytics platforms.

Your impact will be shaping how customers harness Teradata’s VantageCloud and data warehouse capabilities through AI-driven insights, automation, and intelligent applications. You will set the roadmap for embedding AI into mission-critical workloads, balancing innovation with performance, governance, and compliance.

Success in this role will be measured by delivering enterprise-grade AI solutions optimized for hybrid and multi-cloud deployments, unlocking measurable customer value while ensuring scalability, reliability, and cost-efficiency of AI workloads.

Who You Will Work With

On our team, we collaborate with engineering, cloud infrastructure, data science, UX, and governance functions to bring next-generation AI capabilities into Teradata’s enterprise ecosystem. We are responsible for the product vision, roadmap, and execution of AI initiatives, ensuring they meet both business and technical objectives.

This role reports to the VP of Product Management and will partner closely with product engineering and platform leaders worldwide. You will act as the strategic AI product leader for Teradata, influencing global product direction.

What Makes You a Qualified Candidate

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or related field (PhD preferred).
  • 10+ years of product management experience, including 5+ years leading AI/ML or advanced analytics products.
  • Deep technical expertise in AI/ML concepts, including LLMs, foundation models, supervised/unsupervised learning, fine-tuning, inference pipelines, and multi-modal AI.
  • Proven success embedding AI into enterprise-scale platforms, especially in data management, analytics, or cloud environments.
  • Strong technical fluency with AI infrastructure — including distributed training, inference optimization, GPU/accelerator integration, and workload orchestration.
  • Experience defining APIs, SDKs, and developer integrations for enterprise AI adoption.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of hybrid and multi-cloud architectures and their impact on AI performance, scalability, and cost optimization.
  • Familiarity with governance and compliance frameworks (HIPAA, GDPR, SOC2) and applying them to AI/ML solutions.
  • Exceptional communication skills with the ability to influence C-level stakeholders and articulate AI product strategy.
  • Track record of customer engagement, market analysis, and competitive benchmarking in enterprise software.

What You Will Bring

  • Expertise in optimizing AI workloads across cloud and hybrid environments, ensuring cost-efficiency and performance at scale.
  • Hands-on knowledge of GPU, TPU, and emerging accelerator technologies for training, inference, and fine-tuning AI models.
  • Ability to bridge AI model development with structured and unstructured enterprise data at petabyte scale.
  • A strong understanding of responsible AI, including fairness, explainability, auditability, and bias detection.
  • Vision to anticipate industry trends and position Teradata’s AI offerings as differentiated and enterprise-ready.
  • Passion for enabling intuitive, AI-powered user experiences (e. g. , natural language query, automated insights, intelligent automation).
  • Ability to operate as a senior leader — setting strategy, guiding technical direction, and influencing globally.

Why We Think You'll Love Teradata

We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are committed to actively working to foster an inclusive environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.

title: Head of Product - Smart Buildings
descriptionHtml:
Head of Product – Smart Buildings Embassy 247 IT Park, Vikhroli, Mumbai | 15–20 years experience required


Mandatory Requirement

IoT or hardware experience essential. Applicants with SaaS-only backgrounds will not be considered. Freespace (afreespace.com) delivers workplace intelligence through IoT sensors, real time analytics, employee apps, signage, and space management—driving optimized designs, smart automations, and exceptional employee experiences.


Role Overview

Lead product vision, strategy, and execution for global IoT products in occupancy sensing, air quality, energy monitoring, and building management. Bridge customers, vendors, and teams to boost efficiency, sustainability, and occupant experience. Own customer growth, revenue, profitability; manage Product Owners, Analysts, and Solution Experts.


Key Responsibilities

• Define bold product vision/strategy and quarterly roadmaps aligned to growth goals, market trends, and client needs.

• Engage US/UK/global clients in meetings; capture feedback, analyze NPS, and refine offerings.

• Track KPIs (adoption, retention, quality); oversee lifecycle from ideation to scale, reviewing support tickets.

• Drive commercial success: pricing, monetization (subscriptions/licensing), margins via exec collaboration. • Partner with GTM/marketing/sales on positioning, launches, and global product market fit.

• Lead Agile processes: backlog grooming, sprint planning/reviews, trade-offs, fostering autonomous teams.

• Ensure compliance (BACnet/MQTT/Modbus, LEED/BREEAM), security, and vendor integrations for sensors/edge/cloud.

• Communicate roadmaps to stakeholders; champion research on competitors, trends, and customer behavior.


Required Experience & Skills

• 15–20 years in IoT/Smart Buildings (8+ in leadership); proven scaling of enterprise IoT solutions globally. • Commercial expertise: pricing, revenue growth, client negotiations.

• Deep IoT knowledge: sensors, embedded systems, protocols (Wi Fi/BLE/LoRaWAN), edge computing, HVAC/lighting integration.

• Cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), data analytics, device-to-cloud comms, cybersecurity (encryption/firmware).

• Agile mastery: user stories, sprints, metrics (NPS/retention); strong analytics and stakeholder management.

• UI prototyping/wireframing; primary/secondary research; negotiation; team leadership. Must-Haves Nice-to-Haves IoT/hardware leadership Energy optimization strategies Global product scaling BMS integrations Agile + commercial ownership Sustainability certifications Ideal Candidate Visionary who thrives in ambiguity, with sharp logic, ideation skills, and cross-team relationship building. Why Freespace?

• Interact with global customers Freespace Confidential • Shape cutting-edge IoT for sustainable workplaces.

• Hybrid flexibility, growth-focused culture.

• Competitive salary/bonus, health benefits, paid leave, training.


Apply now: Send CV to hrindia@afreespace.com by 30th June 2026. We value diverse applicants.
