title: Director, Product Management
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Director, Product Management.

About The Job

Twilio is looking for a Director, Product Management, to help deliver on our strategic vision for the Twilio Flex product that is part of the Twilio Platform. In this role, you will be responsible for the features, UI, APIs, Agentic approach, and documentation that powers the Flex product ecosystem. You will help define and drive the roadmap that enables internal teams, partners, third-party developers, and customers to innovate and scale their contact center solutions on Twilio. As a strategic leader, you collaborate closely with other product leaders, Engineering, Architecture, and Go-To-Market teams to deliver robust, scalable, and forward-looking Flex capabilities. As a leader and manager, you will manage and lead a team of strong individual Product Managers. And finally, as a key leader of the Twilio India location, you will help guide and shape the working experience of hundreds of other Twilions as you partner with senior leadership in Bangalore, India.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Define, build, and execute a comprehensive product roadmap for the foundational services, APIs, and developer infrastructure powering the Twilio Flex product ecosystem.
  • Lead the evolution of Twilio Flex from a standalone application into a set of decomposable, AI-native components, aligning with Twilio’s strategic platform vision.
  • Provide clear ownership, hands-on product management, managing roadmap execution, and operational oversight for the consolidated Flex Product Management team.
  • Manage and mentor a team of strong individual Product Managers, fostering a culture of technical rigor, continuous learning, and high performance.
  • Champion an outstanding customer experience by driving improvements in APIs, SDKs, documentation, and tooling for internal teams, partners, and external developers.
  • Collaborate closely with Engineering, Architecture, Design, and Go-to-Market teams to deliver robust, scalable, and forward-looking Flex capabilities.
  • Serve as a key leader for the Twilio India site, partnering with senior leadership in Bangalore to guide and shape the working experience of hundreds of other Twilions.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

  • Required:
  • 15+ years of product management experience, with at least 4 years as a manager leading platform or infrastructure-focused product teams.
  • Proven experience in developing and managing platform products such as APIs, developer tools, and cloud-native infrastructure.
  • Strong technical acumen and ability to engage deeply with engineering teams on architectural trade-offs, scalability, and highly distributed systems.
  • At least 5 years experience working on multi-tenant SaaS and cloud platforms.
  • Experience in the Contact Center (CCaaS) or Customer Engagement Platform (CEP) space.
  • Demonstrated ability to hire, manage, and mentor a team of Product Managers.
  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent work experience.

Desired

  • Familiarity with Voice AI, Agentic frameworks, and AI use in Contact Center products.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively across time zones with globally distributed teams.

Location

This role will be remote, and based in India (only in Karnataka, TamilNadu, Maharashtra, Delhi, Telangana).

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

title: Director, Product Management
descriptionHtml:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director, Product Management based in India.

This is a senior product leadership role focused on shaping and scaling a next-generation communications platform powering enterprise contact center experiences. You will own the vision, strategy, and execution for a core product ecosystem spanning APIs, UI capabilities, developer tools, and AI-enabled components that enable customers and partners to build scalable, intelligent engagement solutions. The role sits at the intersection of platform innovation, developer experience, and enterprise SaaS transformation. You will lead and mentor a team of experienced Product Managers while driving alignment across Engineering, Architecture, Design, and Go-To-Market functions. With a strong focus on AI-native evolution, you will help transform a leading contact center product into a modular, decomposed platform of services. This role also carries significant leadership responsibility within the India hub, influencing culture, execution, and ways of working across a large distributed organization. It is an opportunity to have both deep product impact and broad organizational influence in a global, fast-scaling environment.

Accountabilities

  • Define and lead the product vision, roadmap, and execution strategy for platform services, APIs, and developer infrastructure powering a large-scale contact center ecosystem
  • Drive the evolution of the product into modular, AI-native, and decomposable platform components aligned with long-term architecture strategy
  • Own end-to-end product delivery, ensuring strong alignment between roadmap priorities, engineering execution, and business outcomes
  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Product Managers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, ownership, and continuous improvement
  • Champion world-class developer and customer experiences through improvements in APIs, SDKs, documentation, and tooling
  • Collaborate closely with Engineering, Architecture, Design, and Go-To-Market teams to deliver scalable and resilient platform capabilities
  • Act as a key leadership figure within the India site, contributing to organizational culture, talent development, and cross-team alignment

Requirements

  • 10+ years of product management experience, including at least 4+ years in a leadership role managing platform or infrastructure product teams
  • Proven experience building and scaling platform products such as APIs, developer tools, or cloud-native SaaS infrastructure
  • Strong technical depth with the ability to engage in architectural discussions and evaluate trade-offs in distributed systems
  • Experience working on multi-tenant SaaS platforms at scale
  • Background in Contact Center (CCaaS) or Customer Engagement Platform (CEP) domains preferred
  • Demonstrated success in hiring, leading, and mentoring high-performing Product Management teams
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills across global, cross-functional teams
  • Familiarity with AI-driven systems, Voice AI, or agentic frameworks is a strong advantage
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience in a relevant field

Benefits

  • Competitive executive-level compensation package aligned with experience
  • Performance-based incentives and long-term growth opportunities
  • Fully remote flexibility within India with global team collaboration
  • Comprehensive healthcare, wellness, and parental support programs
  • Generous paid time off and additional wellbeing leave policies
  • Opportunity to shape a flagship global platform product at scale
  • High-impact leadership role with visibility across global engineering and product teams
  • Strong learning culture with exposure to cutting-edge AI and platform technologies.

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: Head - Application & Product Development
descriptionHtml:
Position Title - Head - Application & Product Development

Years of Experience - 18 to 22

Location - Vilayat, Bharuch, Gujarat


Job Purpose

Establish a fully developed Research & Development Centre targeting to Applied research for Chlor-Alkali products to bring in improvement /value addition to existing Products /Processes and develop a range of products, applications and product variants to suit requirements for Industrial/ water treatment/ Plastic and allied sector aligned to business objective.

Build strong technical competence in resolving customer problems, testing, analysis for Chlor-Alkali products with support for required certification of products.


Key Result Areas


1 - Establishment Research center & execution of research: Identification and execution of long term projects & goals for R&D Centre

  • Identify new segments and markets that require new products and work in collaboration with marketing to develop new products and applications
  • Establishment of Plasticizer Centre
  • Chart out the mandate for the Application Development Center
  • Prepare and pursue Annual P&B for R & D Centre and seek necessary budget approvals
  • Preparation of monthly MIS dashboards and deck presentation in reviews. (Meeting with BH, SBU Head & CMO)
  • Selection of skilled technical resources at R&D Centre

2 - New Product & Application development: Develop applications/ new product development and formulations

  • Understand and analyze the existing market trends, in-house competencies and propose development.
  • Ensure field testing of products to map them to the range of applications.
  • Work closely with Supply chain in optimizing and standardizing raw materials and testing procedures

3 - Recognition, accreditation, collaboration & certification: Identify and collaborate with various bodies for recognitions, accreditations as well collaborate with institutes for research projects and product Certification

  • Coordinate with Government agencies to complete the requisites and file necessary applications.
  • Identify and collaborate with recognized institutes/ organization to collaborate on the research projects.
  • Identification of required certification and ensuring requirement for existing ceritficates for all the products for DCA
  • Supporting the Units for annual audits and ensuring closure of NCs

4 - Product Improvement: Ensure product consistency and improvement by pilot trials.

Monitor, audit and control all testing procedures and set benchmark for product standards.

  • Extend support to the manufacturing team for improvement in existing products and processes.
  • Set up pilot tests, quality plans, procedures, documentations and report
  • Assist marketing in developing product data sheets, brochures, and other supporting documents

5 - Process Improvement: Ensure process reliability by pilot trials.

Monitor, audit and control all testing procedures and set benchmark for process standards.

  • Extend support to the manufacturing team for improvement in existing processes.
  • Set up pilot tests, quality plans, procedures, documentations and report

6 - People development & management: Managing and motivating team and ensure team has relevant skill set and abilities to perform.

  • Have clear goals & review mechanism for all the team members.
  • Formulate training plans for the Team.
  • Provide regular guidance, motivation & clear directions to team members.

7 - Technical support to customers & sales team: Responsible for building expertise and capabilities and support customers and internal team on technical front.

  • Build knowledge pool at Center by evaluating raw material, products and applications.
  • Regular trainings on NPD/ Application/ trends for internal team and dealers / customers
  • Closely work with customers to identify issues and accordingly work out solutions
  • Organize pilot and plant scale trails at customer site
  • Management of customer complaints, Improvement and communication to management

8 - Communication & IPR

  • Attend seminars and exhibitions to make presentations research findings.
  • Ensure publication and patenting of research findings

9 - Safety & policies: Ensuring Safety practices and implementation of policies

  • Ensuring safety practices in the laboratory at all levels including metrological conditions
  • Ensure implementation of all the HR processes and policies

title: Head of Product
descriptionHtml:
About Flexmoney

Flexmoney’s mission is to “Re-imagine Consumer Credit” for the mobile-first digital

consumer. Our omni-channel embedded finance affordability platform enables merchants,

brands and partners to seamlessly embed contextual affordability options across all customer

touchpoints and sales channels, so as to drive higher conversion and increase customer

satisfaction and loyalty. We work with trusted lending partners (Banks, NBFCs, FinTechs) to

develop and offer RBI-compliant, digital credit products embedded in consumer journeys.


Flexmoney was instrumental in working with Banks and merchants to create and establish

the “Cardless EMI” product category in the market, enabling lenders to offer a fully digital

transacting EMI instrument to their users at checkout without the need for a credit card.


We power Cardless affordability for 68,000+ online merchants (including marquee

merchants such as Flipkart, Amazon and MakeMyTrip) across categories such as travel,

insurance, home, fashion, sports, electronics, mobiles, health and wellness.


Role Overview:

We’re looking for a Product Head to own and drive the product vision, strategy, and

execution for Flexmoney’s affordability platform. This is a high-ownership role for someone

who has built and scaled enterprise / B2B products from early traction to meaningful scale —

ideally through the 1→10 and 10→100 phases. You will lead a team of 6–7 product managers

and work at the intersection of merchants, lenders, and consumers to build the infrastructure

that makes EMI-based purchases seamless across India’s merchant network.


This is not a “maintain and optimize” role – while v1 of our suite is in-market, we foresee a

rich roadmap ahead as commerce increasingly splits into new channels such as social,

influencer-led and agentic. We are looking for someone who can think from first principles,

make hard trade-offs, and build products that merchants/brands and partners genuinely want

to adopt and scale with. In addition, the successful candidate will have a commercial mindset

and work with our Sales, Partner and Business teams to collaboratively identify and ship new

features to drive additional value for our customers and new revenue opportunities for

Flexmoney.


Key Responsibilities:

• You will own the end-to-end product roadmap for Flexmoney’s omni-channel digital

affordability suite — spanning merchant-facing omni-channel commerce journeys

(consumer onboarding, personalized financing offers surfacing, checkout experiences,

merchant dashboard) lender integrations, and consumer EMI experiences.

• In addition, you and your team will define the core digital credit platform roadmap

allowing multi-lender seamless financing as a service in every customer journey

• Define and drive product strategy aligned with business goals, working closely with

the CEO, engineering, business, and lending partnerships teams.

• Lead, mentor, and scale a product team of 5–7 PMs — setting the bar for rigour in

problem definition, prioritisation, and execution.

• Be the voice of the customer. Deeply understand merchant and partner needs, pain

points, and workflows to build products that drive adoption, activation, and retention.

• Drive platform scalability — you’ve been through the messy middle of scaling a product

from early-stage traction to a platform serving thousands of businesses, and you know

what breaks and what holds.

• Own key product metrics: merchant activation rates, EMI transaction conversion,

disbursal throughput, lender partner NPS, and platform reliability.

• Work with engineering to make smart technical trade-offs, manage technical debt,

and ship with velocity without compromising quality.

• Build and institutionalise product processes — discovery, spec writing, sprint planning,

launch readiness, and post-launch reviews — appropriate for Flexmoney’s stage.


Qualifications:

Must-Have:

• 8+ years of product management experience, with at least 3–4 years in Ecommerce /

commerce enablement / Enterprise / B2B / B2B2C product roles.

• Demonstrated experience scaling products through the 1→10 and 10→100 growth

phases — not just 0→1 ideation.

• Strong merchant-facing or partner-facing product experience — you’ve built products

where the buyer is a business (not a consumer), and you understand enterprise sales

cycles, integration complexity, and partner success.

• Experience managing and growing a product team of 6+ people, including hiring,

coaching, and performance management.

• Ability to operate at both the strategic (quarterly roadmap, market positioning) and

tactical (user stories, edge cases, release management) levels.

• Strong analytical skills — comfortable with data, metrics, and making decisions with

imperfect information.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, particularly with C-

suite, engineering leadership, and external partners.


Strong Bonus:

• Prior experience in lending, fintech, payments, or consumer credit / EMI infrastructure.

• Familiarity with India Stack (Aadhaar, UPI, BBPS, Account Aggregator) and how it

shapes product design in financial services.

• Experience with platform / marketplace dynamics — multi-sided products where you’re

serving merchants, lenders, and consumers simultaneously.

• Background in checkout, payment gateway, EMI, or point-of-sale product ecosystems.


Why Flexmoney?

• You’ll have an opportunity to work closely with the Founder/CEO of the Company and

real influence on Company direction.

• Flexmoney sits at the intersection of affordability, payments, and commerce —

powering how India’s merchants make purchases accessible through EMI.

• Small, high-calibre team (~60 people) with deep domain expertise in banking,

consumer internet, and infrastructure — zero bureaucracy.

• The product-market fit is proven with 73M+ credit-verified users and 68,000+

merchants. The opportunity now is to scale — which is exactly the kind of problem this

role is designed to solve.

title: Head of Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Position: Head of Engineering

Industry: Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS)

Location: Mysore


Job Summary:

We are seeking a strategic, hands-on Engineering Head to lead the entire engineering function at a fast-growing Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) company. You will be responsible for driving technical excellence across New Product Introduction (NPI), process engineering, design for manufacturability (DFM), test engineering, and continuous improvement. The role demands deep expertise in electronics manufacturing (SMT, PCB assembly, box-build, and high-mix, low-to-medium-volume production) and the ability to translate customer requirements into scalable, cost-effective, high-quality manufacturing solutions.

You will lead a multi-disciplinary team (Process, Test, Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, and Quality Engineering) while partnering closely with customers (OEMs/ODMs), Sales, Operations, Supply Chain, and Quality teams.


Key Responsibilities:


Strategic Leadership

  • Own the complete engineering roadmap and technology strategy for the EMS business.
  • Define and drive engineering KPIs: NPI cycle time, first-pass yield, process capability (CpK), cost of poor quality, and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE).
  • Lead digital transformation initiatives in manufacturing (Industry 4.0, automation, MES, AI/ML for defect detection).

New Product Introduction (NPI) & Customer Engineering

  • Lead end-to-end NPI from customer RFQ to mass production handover.
  • Conduct Design for Manufacturability (DFM), Design for Assembly (DFA), Design for Testability (DFT), and Design for Cost (DFC) reviews.
  • Provide value engineering and alternate component engineering support to customers.

Process & Manufacturing Engineering

  • Develop, standardize, and continuously improve SMT, PTH, selective soldering, conformal coating, potting, box-build, and system integration processes.
  • Own process validation, PFMEA, control plans, and process capability studies.
  • Drive automation and smart factory projects (robotic soldering, AOI, AXI, ICT, FCT, burn-in).

Quality & Reliability

  • Ensure compliance with IPC-A-610, IPC-7711/7721, ISO 9001, IATF 16949 (if applicable), RoHS, REACH, and customer-specific standards.
  • Lead root-cause analysis (8D, Fishbone, DOE) for critical defects and field failures.


People & Team Management

  • Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing engineering team.
  • Create succession plans and a technical competency matrix for the function.
  • Foster a culture of innovation, ownership, and data-driven decision making.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Sales & Marketing for technical pre-sales support and customer presentations.
  • Work with Operations for production ramp-up, line balancing, and capacity planning.
  • Interface with Supply Chain on component engineering and obsolescence management.


Required Qualifications & Experience:

Education

  • Bachelor’s / Master’s degree in Electronics & Communications/ Electrical / (or equivalent).
  • Certifications: Six Sigma Black Belt / Green Belt, IPC certifications (CID/CIT preferred), PMP is a plus.

Experience

  • 12–18 years of total experience in Electronics Manufacturing / EMS / ODM industry.
  • Minimum 6–8 years in a senior leadership role (Engineering Manager / Sr. Engineering Manager / Head of Engineering).
  • Proven track record of successfully launching 50+ complex electronic products (automotive, medical, industrial, consumer, telecom, or aerospace).
  • Hands-on experience with high-volume SMT lines (minimum 5–7 lines) and box-build operations.

Technical Expertise

  • Deep knowledge of SMT processes (screen printing, placement, reflow, wave, selective soldering).
  • Strong understanding of test strategy development (AOI, AXI, ICT, FCT, JTAG, Boundary Scan).
  • Experience with CAD tools (Valor, Allegro, SolidWorks), ERP (SAP/Oracle), and MES systems.
  • Knowledge of materials, PCBA reliability, and failure analysis techniques.

Leadership & Behavioural Competencies

  • Strong business acumen and customer-centric mindset.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
  • Proven ability to drive cost reduction and productivity improvement projects (target 8–15% YoY).
  • High-energy, results-oriented, and comfortable in a fast-paced EMS environment.

Preferred Advantages

  • Experience in setting up greenfield EMS plants or new process lines.
  • Exposure to global customers (US, Europe, Japan) and international quality standards.
  • Knowledge of emerging technologies: SiP, 5G modules, EV electronics, medical device manufacturing, or Industry 4.0 implementations.

title: Regional Sales Head - B2B
descriptionHtml:
Position - Regional Sales Head - B2B

Experience - 8+ years

Location - Lower Parel


Lafit Lighting, a leading Indian brand in premium LED lighting, is recognized for its innovative and high-quality LED products. For over two decades, the company has been dedicated to delivering top-tier lighting solutions. With a spacious head office, two experience centers, and a cutting-edge manufacturing facility in Upper Thane, Mumbai, Lafit consistently broadens its product offerings and market presence through extensive R&D, catering to the growing demand for luxurious and innovative décor solutions.

Strategic:

title: Head of Editorial Performance, Nature Portfolio
descriptionHtml:
Job Title: Head of Editorial Performance, Nature Portfolio

Location: London or Pune

Reports to: Director of Editorial Performance, Nature Portfolio

Application Deadline: 28th June 2026

About The Springer Nature Group

Springer Nature is one of the leading publishers of research in the world. We publish the largest number of journals and books and are a pioneer in open research. Through our leading brands, trusted for more than 180 years, we provide technology-enabled products, platforms and services that help researchers to uncover new ideas and share their discoveries, health professionals to stay at the forefront of medical science, and educators to advance learning. We are proud to be part of progress, working together with the communities we serve to share knowledge and bring greater understanding to the world. For more information, please visit about.springernature.com and @SpringerNature.

About The Brand

Nature Portfolio is a flagship portfolio of journals, products and services including Nature and the Nature-branded journals, dedicated to serving the scientific community.

About The Role

The Head of Editorial Performance is responsible for developing and driving initiatives in support of driving operational excellence across the Nature Portfolio. In this role you will be working with key stakeholders across the Nature Portfolio editorial teams as well as Peer Review Management, Content Acquisition Product team, Publishing Strategy, Publishing Performance & Intelligence, Production, Publishing Operations, and others, to plan and implement improvements to editorial workflows and processes, and drive the adoption of best working practices, to support increased editorial efficiency and best-in-class author experience.

An immediate priority for the role-holder will be to take on a leading role in delivering an ambitious ongoing project to transform Nature Portfolio’s editorial workflows. This is an exciting opportunity to be involved in shaping efficient and scalable future-ready workflows.

Responsibilities

  • Lead initiatives to improve and standardise editorial workflows across Nature Portfolio.
  • Analyse current processes, identify improvement opportunities, and design scalable solutions.
  • Deliver change projects from planning through implementation, including milestones, risks, dependencies and success measures.
  • Drive adoption of new workflows, technologies and platforms across editorial teams.
  • Partner with stakeholders across editorial, product, operations, production and analytics teams to deliver effective change.
  • Use data and KPIs to track impact, measure success and support continuous improvement.
  • Support the development of best practices and portfolio-wide approaches to editorial processes.
  • Contribute to initiatives that improve author experience and operational efficiency.

Essential

Skills, Experience & Qualifications

  • Good understanding of editorial workflows and the research publishing landscape.
  • Strong experience leading complex projects and change initiatives in cross-functional environments.
  • Experience supporting the adoption of new processes, systems or technologies.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills, with a data-informed approach.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain complex ideas clearly.
  • Ability to influence, build trust and work effectively across a wide range of teams and senior stakeholders.
  • Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage priorities and deliver against deadlines.
  • Proactive, self-motivated and comfortable working independently.
  • Degree-level qualification or equivalent relevant professional experience.

Desirable

  • Project management qualification or formal training.

Applicants should submit a CV and a cover letter outlining your key ambitions for the role, preferred office location and current notice period.

Springer Nature Skills associated with this job profile include: SN-Strategic Mindset, SN-Manages Complexity, SN-Decision Quality, SN-Balances Stakeholders, SN-Communicates Effectively, SN-Persuasion, SN-Collaboration, SN-Project Management, SN-Data Analytics, SN-Operational Excellence.

At Springer Nature, our mission is to be part of progress – and that begins with inclusion: of people, perspectives, and ideas. We believe that diverse perspectives drive progress, and we are committed to creating an environment where people and ideas can flourish. If you have any access needs related to disability, neurodivergence or a chronic condition, please contact us so we can make all necessary accommodation. Find out more about our DEI work here: https://group.springernature.com/gp/group/taking-responsibility/diversity-equity-inclusion.

For more information about career opportunities in Springer Nature please visit https://springernature.wd3.myworkdayjobs.com/SpringerNatureCareers/.

Job Posting End Date:

15-06-2026

title: Head - Retail Operations and Project Execution (Furniture) (PSS07881)
descriptionHtml:
About The Company

A leading modular furniture enterprise in India, the organization operates a fully integrated manufacturing setup powered by advanced European technology. As it scales rapidly through Exclusive Brand Outlets (EBOs), the company is focused on building a retail engine that delivers speed, consistency, strong unit economics, and superior customer experience at scale.

Position Overview

The Head – Retail Operations & Execution is a mission-critical leadership role reporting to the Founder (Retail Business Head). The position is responsible for building and running the execution backbone of the retail business, influencing product selection, pricing structures, and sales decisions to ensure profitable, scalable, and execution-friendly growth. The role owns the entire lifecycle from order finalisation to project handover, managing 300+ projects/month across cities with full accountability for timelines, quality, cost, and customer experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with Sales, Design, and Category teams to align product selection with manufacturing capability and execution feasibility.
  • Influence product mix standardisation and SKU rationalisation to improve scalability and reduce complexity.
  • Provide on-ground cost intelligence to support pricing and validate project-level commercials for feasibility.
  • Act as backend support to Sales for closing high-quality, execution-ready orders and reducing rework or mis-selling.
  • Own the complete lifecycle from order validation to final handover, ensuring adherence to TAT, quality, and cost benchmarks.
  • Manage and monitor 300+ projects per month across multiple cities, building systems for real-time tracking and control.
  • Align closely with Manufacturing Operations and Supply Chain to ensure seamless coordination from factory to site.
  • Standardise installation processes, improve productivity, and drive on-time, first-time-right project completion.
  • Own cost and margin management, driving optimisation across design, production, logistics, and installation.
  • Build a central operations control tower for end-to-end visibility and proactive risk management.
  • Ensure superior last-mile customer experience through predictable timelines and quick resolution of escalations.
  • Develop scalable SOPs, dashboards, and governance mechanisms to track key metrics and ensure process discipline.
  • Build and lead a high-performance, multi-city operations team with clear KRAs and a culture of execution excellence.


Required Experience & Qualifications

  • Experience: 18–20+ years in operations, execution, or project delivery roles.
  • Leadership: Proven ability to manage multi-city teams and complex coordination across functions.
  • Technical Expertise: Deep domain knowledge in modular furniture, interiors, kitchens, or similar industries; strong understanding of product-category linkage, pricing, cost structures, and margin management.
  • Soft Skills: Highly hands-on, structured, and execution-driven; strong collaboration with sales and category teams; disciplined and customer-focused leadership style.


Why Consider this Opportunity?

  • Lead the operational backbone of a rapidly scaling retail business with national reach.
  • Drive end-to-end accountability across 300+ projects/month impacting customer experience and profitability.
  • Shape pricing, product, and execution strategies in close partnership with the Founder and leadership team.
  • Build and institutionalize systems, processes, and governance frameworks for scalable growth.
  • Be part of a high-growth environment combining manufacturing excellence with retail innovation.

title: Director - Electrical Sector Global
descriptionHtml:
At Eaton India Innovation Center, we are looking for a Director - Electrical Sector Global.

Job Summary

  • The purpose of this leadership role is to lead GEIS (Global Energy Infrastructure Solutions) and EMEA in EIIC (Eaton India Innovation Center) Engineering Organization, drive IoT platform strategy across & effectively insert them across the broader electrical sector (working with various EIIC divisional groups).
  • Work directly with regional general managers (including GEIS India and China GM) and drive additional growth in the region, drive re-use, common process and platforms across various EIIC groups and including EMEA site.
  • Drive stronger integration with the local research labs team (ERL India) and mature product insertions quicker.
  • The role needs to define product ownership and execution strategies for the identified product lines from the global GEIS organization (50% of global head count is in EIIC). This includes organization skill and talent build up, deeply integrating cross functionally across the plants, product management and engineering, developing deep product technical expertise to peform wall to wall ownership (concept to launch and after-market support) and bring-in differentiated solutions to market.
  • Responsible for Implementing strategies focused around Electrical Product which encompasses EMEA PMCC, Critical Systems, VAVE & Energy Transition and Digitalization teams for product design life experience along with expanded job responsibilities for APAC region.
  • Work with Product engineering directors to formulate & execute MGPP and MGTP in sync with growth goals for EMEA and APAC.
  • Shape Focus area and build portfolio that matters. Define clear road map for next 3 - 5 years and execute action items to mitigate identified gaps. Leverage newly built EIIC ecosystem for prototype and validation to accelerate time to market.
  • Build footprint and define capability roadmap in APAC region through regional growth strategy at organization level.
  • Define DMP strategy for EMEA and APAC division in line with global DMP targets. Shape and execute big bet projects. Identify DtV projects and execute identified DtV projects as per VA ProLaunch methodology.
  • Build partnership with newly formed DMP organization and own engineering deliverables to shape and execute commodity projects.
  • Promote culture of CI and automation to improve OTD and FPY.
  • Define Digitalization strategy for various products considering competitor landscape working closely with Electrical Sector and Digital organization.
  • Build culture of innovation through planned events, participating in brain storming. Identify opportunities for filling disclosures and execute division goals for IP.
  • Work closely with product teams to drive product synergies.
  • Collaborate closely with other Engineering Centers and other Engineering Teams to build Engineering footprint and contribute towards ""Simplify for Growth"" strategy for ES EMEA and APAC Region.
  • Lead and develop capabilities for a team of 210+ engineers. Works closely with LSD, PDD, PQED & ICPD facilities in EMEA Region for New Product Developments, Cost out, sustaining and application engineering projects.


What You’ll Do

  • Execute and Manage as per the strategic direction provided by each of the business division. Align with product strategy. Provides leadership for the team to meet its short and long term goals.
  • Provide leadership to innovate new differentiating products and services.. Lead innovation events to shape ideas from the team
  • Lead strategic initiatives to improve the overall execution performance, reliability, cost and manufacturability. Provide leadership, coaching, and mentoring for ""GEIS"", “EMEA” and ""APAC"" Engineers and related COE team at EIIC to develop innovative electrical and mechanical designs for electrical Equipment and come up with digital solutions
  • Develop and control the schedule and direct the work in order to effectively manage time. Monitor progress & achievements on projects. Provide regular reports on development & support activities
  • Manage and develop people: identify, attract and develop key engineering talent for the organization. Develop successors in the organization
  • Recruit and retain a team of engineers and support staff to provide both local product development and engineering services to the global engineering needs. Train, develop & motivate subordinates to achieve their professional goals & review their accomplishments.
  • NPI efficacy and predictable execution on programs - Design cycle time reduction, Analysis first approach
  • Build Organization Capabilities - Hire and develop talents for EMEA and APAC Region business divisions.
  • Develop depth of capabilities in product engineering in Electrical, Mechanical, firmware and software as well as adjacent technology areas from Centers of Excellence (for e.g Modelling and Simulation CoE).
  • Enable synergies for growth: Use of common CoE platforms in product development to improve Time to Market, Enhance effectiveness for ES
  • Manages department budget and performance to forecast
  • Utilizes DFSS concepts / tools such as PDSC, P-Diagram, DFMEA, Risk Management & DVPR for new product development &/or existing product improvements
  • Teach, Mentor and Coach DfX Green belt certifications for EIIC engineering community.


Qualifications

  • Minimum education for this position is a Bachelors in Mechanical / Electrical / Electronics Engineering, preferred is a Masters degree
  • At least 12+ years of leadership experience in a multinational engineering organization and a total of at least 15+ years in leading an interdisciplinary program and/or team.


Skills

  • Should have sound knowledge in Electrical products for Power Distribution, Power Quality, Life Safety and Control Products.
  • Strong background in DFSS with GB/BB certification Drive growth in respective team in terms of breadth and depth of capabilities in Electrical and mechanical design as well as adjacent technology areas in product engineering.
  • Proven track record of demonstrating competencies to manage a large and diverse team.
  • Strong leadership potential and be in a succession role.


We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for job applicants and employees. Our recruitment processes use balanced selection criteria and avoid unlawful discrimination against applicants on the basis of their age, colour, disability, marital status, national origin, gender, gender identity, genetic information, race or racial origin, religion, sexual orientation or any other status protected or required by law.

title: Head of Marketplaces
descriptionHtml:
Are you looking to scale one of India's fastest-growing global wearable brands from right here in Bangalore?

At Ultrahuman, our in-house Ai-platform already does the heavy lifting across 100+ countries, leaving you to ditch the bloated corporate headcount and actually build.

If the challenge of managing a massive, multi-country Amazon P&L with a lean team and cutting-edge AI excites you, read on.


Ultrahuman is one of the world's fastest-growing wearable companies. The Ultrahuman Ring AIR — the world's lightest sleep-tracking smart ring — sells in 100+ countries. We operate like a product company in every function, and marketplaces is no exception: our Amazon business across the UK, Germany, Canada, Australia, India, the UAE and beyond runs on uh-amazon, an in-house platform we built ourselves.


Role: Head of Marketplaces

Location: Begur, Bengaluru

Schedule: Hybrid.


Why this role exists

Most marketplace-head roles are dashboard jobs with a layer of geo managers underneath. This one is the inverse. The platform already surfaces what is wrong, everywhere, every day. Your job is to decide and to lead a tiny team that acts on pricing, on the channel model for each geo, on the ads turnaround — and to keep the team tiny by pushing routine work back onto the platform.


What you'll own

·      The global P&L — every Amazon geo plus Flipkart, noon, and quick-commerce partners; the number is yours

·      Pricing and promotions — discounts, coupons, MAP enforcement, and price-match decisions across all geos

·      Channel-model decisions — self-run 3P vs 1P/vendor vs distributor sell-in, geo by geo; several need this call in your first quarter

·      The ads turnaround — your first mandate is to fix the loss-making spend in the largest geos and take ownership of advertising efficiency

·      A team of three to four — two operators (you hire them), a platform engineer, and a part-time claims function

·      New-marketplace launches — under a simple filter: real demand, a partner-operated model by default, clear economics, and a named owner; never a launch without one

·      Agent-write approvals — as the platform earns the right to act (ads changes, repricing, listing pushes), you own the guardrails and the gates


Your first 90 days

·      Days 1–30 — Learn the machine. Run with the platform's daily briefs. Audit the biggest ads accounts yourself. Meet the 1P, distributor, and agency relationships. Sit with the engineer on what the agents can and cannot do.

·      Days 31–60 — Take the controls. Pricing authority moves to you. The ads turnaround shows its first month of recovered spend. Both operator hires are made.

·      Days 61–90 — Set the trajectory. Publish the 12-month plan: the channel model per geo, the growth bets, and the write-automation roadmap with your engineer.


What we're looking for

·      5+ years running marketplace or e-commerce P&Ls across multiple geographies — at a brand, an aggregator, or leading accounts at a top agency — with direct ownership of outcomes

·      Hands-on Seller Central depth — you have personally restructured campaigns, fixed suppressed listings, fought brand-registry cases, and run promotions; we will test this live

·      Genuine fluency with LLM systems — you have personally written and iterated prompts and can read code well enough to review an agent's behavior; we will test this live too

·      Lean-org conviction — at least one concrete example of solving a scale problem with systems instead of headcount, with numbers

·      Data fluency — you can interrogate a funnel, spot a regression, and call out a vanity metric; SQL comfort helps

·      Bangalore, in-office


Strongly preferred

·      Aggregator experience (Mensa, GlobalBees, 10Club, Evenflow and the like) — running many brands across many geos with a small team

·      Vendor/1P and distributor-model experience, not just 3P

·      You have shipped something with LLM APIs yourself — a tool, an automation, an eval harness; a public GitHub is a genuine plus

·      Consumer hardware or D2C background


Not required

·      A specific degree, or any degree — we will not ask

·      A prior "Head of" title — if you have been the de-facto operator of a multi-geo marketplace P&L and are ready for the full mandate, apply; the live exercise outranks the resume

·      A wearables background — we will teach you the product; we cannot teach judgment

title: Senior Vice President - PMD (GTS)
descriptionHtml:
Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

Business Descriptor

HSBC is the largest trade and receivable finance organisation in the world, offering a comprehensive range of traditional and structured trade solutions. Global Trade Solutions (GTS) vision is to ‘connect the world through trade’ by bringing the future of trade to our clients.

The role will be responsible for structuring the distribution/ syndication of complex & innovative /bespoke deals across GTS product space with specific focus on Structured Trade Finance transactions such as Inventory Financing, Leasing and Non-bank Financial Institutions trade related financing. The role holder will create, build and scale distribution with new solutions and structures.

The role holder will drive collaboration with internal and external stakeholders to share expertise and strategic guidance on the sector, while strenghening our client relationships and shaping our market expertise on trade finance in this sector.

The role will report to the Regional Head Trade Asset Distribution, Asia.

Principal Responsibilities

  • Sector Expertise/ Impact on the business

Structuring expertise

  • Excellent understanding of GTS Structured Trade Finance products and good understanding of other GTS Products and solutions, including import and export financing, Documentary Credits, Guarantees and Commodity Trade Finance.
  • Ability to structure bespoke and innovative solutions across sectors, products and geographies alongside embedding distribution. Understand the related legal clauses and documentation involved in structuring bespoke multi geography solutions
  • Ability to assess risk dynamics of clients and deals and build adequate risk mitigants to enable a sustainable and risk acceptable structure for the bank and the client
  • Ability to work with senior stakeholders at the clients end, understand their needs, structure bespoke solutions (multi-geography) and co-create innovative propositions to meet client requirements.
  • Thorough understanding of regulatory framework and expertise in implementing multi-geography, multi-product deals

Distribution Expertise

  • In depth knowledge and experience in Trade Asset Distribution from large scale deal origination and sell down. Good understanding of bilateral risk distribution techniques as well as insurance products.
  • Good knowledge of the process of transferring/selling trade risks including legal risks and clauses. Strong understanding of how the secondary market operates and awareness of investor trends and dynamics.
  • Excellent knowledge of how distribution (mitigation or transfer) can help to reduce or eliminate risks in order to achieve for example credit, cross border or balance sheet relief
  • Work closely with Frontline sales managers and grow business volumes and drive balance sheet velocity
  • Professionally and technically solid, must be able to easily interact with sophisticated stakeholders such as Financial Institution investors as well as clients to promote value of distribution
  • Actively manage the risk distribution and risk participation pipeline and facilitate the structuring of complex trade transactions on an end-to-end basis; this covers from deal origination, namely, client needs and solution finding, to coordinating and supervising proper execution by Operations
  • Oversee the Trade Asset Distribution (TAD) in India, covering participation in and distribution of trade risks and Indian trade assets.
  • Represent TAD team in external market bodies/events/conferences to develop market intelligence and establish strong market presence

Sector expertise

  • Be in the inhouse sector expert on GTS global priority sectors, supply chains, regulatory environments and working capital needs
  • Understand current economic trends and impact on HSBC to identify key levers to capitalise on opportunities or minimise downside exposure
  • Drive industry leading best practices across the GTS and Bank network through partnership with internal teams as well as external industry experts, to generate insights and solutions
  • Closely follow the development of ESG solutions for trade finance to embed them in solutions offered to external investors
  • Up skill sales force to drive strategic client conversations via regular teach in sessions, improving client understanding
  • Actively promote TAD value proposition with internal stakeholders through regular calls, sessions, and e-mail communication to raise awareness
  • Customers/ Stakeholders (Internal/External)
  • Work closely with senior client contacts to understand their needs and structure bespoke solutions to match their ask.
  • Support Front Line Sales Managers in pitching and structuring GTS transactions in Asia primarily for Structured Trade Finance transactions (however not limited to this product suite)
  • Coordinate multi-disciplinary teams and stakeholders in order to structure the distribution element of multi-currencies and cross border transactions
  • Manage investor relationships (Financial Institutions, Non-Bank Financial Institutions, and private funds) including identifying and developing new relationships with potential investors in the secondary market
  • Develop the network of key stakeholders, including Global Trade Solution Sales Managers, CIB Relationship Managers, Country Heads of Trade, Regional Head of Product Management, Financial Institutions Group Relationship Managers and Sales Managers, GTS Services, and other key risk stewards
  • Management of Risk (Operational Risk / FIM requirements)
  • The jobholder will ensure the fair treatment of our customers is at the heart of everything we do, both personally and as an organisation.
  • This will be achieved by consistently displaying the behaviours that form part of the HSBC Values and culture and adhering to HSBC risk policies and procedures, including notification and escalation of any concerns and taking required action in relation to points raised by audit and/or external regulators.
  • The jobholder will also continually reassess the operational risks associated with the role and inherent in the business, taking account of changing economic or market conditions, legal and regulatory requirements, operating procedures and practices, management restructurings, and the impact of modern technology.
  • The job holder demonstrates adherence of Regulatory & Compliance matters and maintain awareness of operational risk and minimize the likelihood of it occurring including its identification, assessment, mitigation and control, loss identification and reporting in accordance with GTS FIM.
  • Observation of Internal Controls (Compliance Policy / FIM requirements)

Maintain and observe HSBC internal control standards, implement, and observe Group Compliance Policy, including the timely implementation of recommendations made by internal/external auditors and external regulators. Foster a compliance culture and implement Group Compliance Policy by managing compliance risk in liaison with the Head of Group Compliance, Regional Compliance Officer, or Local Compliance Officer, ensuring adequate compliance resources are in place and training is provided, and optimising relations with regulators.

Role Requirements / Education Qualifications / Certifications / Experience

The base location of this role is India.

Qualifications & Skill Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, related field, or equivalent experience
  • Good knowledge of Trade Products and Services such as Letters of Credit, Guarantees, Receivables Finance, Supply Chain Solutions, Structured Finance
  • Good knowledge of Receivables Finance trade structures and acceptable underlying debt instruments
  • Past working experience in a correlated role, i.e. either GTS sales, structuring team and/or distribution, syndication or Portfolio Management
  • Experience in a Global bank structuring complex multi-jurisdictional transactions
  • Experience of working towards targets and willingness to be assessed against dedicated achievements
  • Robust understanding of the secondary market, established presence, credibility, and recognition in the market
  • Knowledge of Credit Risk Management, good to have experience in managing credit exposure
  • Business oriented, sales experienced, displays strong commercial awareness
  • Excellent organization skills, planning capacity and time management
  • Excellent communication skills: must be able to clearly articulate ideas and persuade with robust arguments
  • In depth knowledge of relevant regulations impacting the business, and the lending and credit approval process and Global Standards
  • Maintain macroeconomic awareness of secondary market trends, dynamics, investor activity, risk appetite, pricing analysis, country risk and ratings, liquidity positions

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited, India

title: Head of Engineering
descriptionHtml:
About the Company


Techlabs Semiconductor Private Limited is a wholly owned subsidiary company of Trident Techlabs Limited, a leading provider of semiconductor services offering comprehensive end-to-end solutions across design, verification, validation, testing, Systems Design, manufacturing and AI. We serve a diverse range of industries, including Consumer Electronics, Automotive, Semiconductor, Telecommunications, Defence, Armed forces and Industrial Automation.


Role Summary

The VP / Head of Engineering will provide strategic, technical, and operational leadership across semiconductor and system-level design services. This role is responsible for driving engineering excellence, scalable delivery, product innovation, and customer success across end-to-end silicon and systems programs.

The ideal candidate brings 20+ years of experience spanning semiconductor product development and engineering services, with deep exposure to customer-facing delivery, global teams, and P&L-aligned execution.


Key Responsibilities

Engineering & Technology Leadership

  • Define and execute the engineering strategy and technology roadmap aligned with company growth objectives.
  • Lead end-to-end engineering across:
  • ASIC / SoC / FPGA design
  • Analog, mixed-signal, and digital design
  • Embedded software, firmware, and system design
  • Verification, validation, DFT, physical design, and silicon bring-up
  • Drive adoption of best-in-class engineering processes, tools, and quality frameworks.

Product & Services Execution

  • Oversee product-oriented and services-led engineering programs, ensuring on-time, on-budget delivery.
  • Balance custom design services, platform-based solutions, and reusable IP strategies.
  • Partner with Product Management to shape solution offerings and differentiation for target markets.

Customer & Business Engagement

  • Act as a technical executive interface for key customers, including design reviews, escalations, and roadmap discussions.
  • Support pre-sales, proposals, and technical due diligence, contributing to deal shaping and closure.
  • Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction, retention, and repeat business.

Organizational Leadership

  • Build, mentor, and retain high-performing global engineering teams across multiple geographies.
  • Establish clear career paths, leadership development, and succession planning.
  • Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Operational Excellence & Governance

  • Own engineering KPIs related to quality, productivity, utilization, and delivery predictability.
  • Manage budgets, headcount planning, and resource allocation aligned with business priorities.
  • Ensure compliance with industry standards, security requirements, and customer quality expectations.


Required Experience & Qualifications

Experience

  • 20+ years of experience in semiconductor and systems engineering, with a strong mix of:
  • Product development
  • Engineering / design services delivery
  • Proven leadership at Director, Senior Director, or VP level managing large, multi-disciplinary teams.
  • Demonstrated success in scaling engineering organizations in a services or hybrid product-services environment.
  • Strong background working with global customers (fabless companies, OEMs, hyperscalers, or Tier-1s).

Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of SoC/ASIC lifecycle, from architecture to silicon qualification.
  • Strong system-level perspective including hardware-software co-design.
  • Familiarity with advanced nodes, IP ecosystems, and EDA workflows is highly desirable.

Leadership & Business Skills

  • Strategic thinker with strong execution discipline.
  • Excellent communication and executive presence, both internal and customer-facing.
  • Proven ability to influence across engineering, sales, product, and executive teams.


Education

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field.
  • MBA or advanced management education is a plus.

title: Head of Sales
descriptionHtml:
Company Description Krishang Pharma Private Limited is a growing pharmaceutical company based in Anand, Gujarat, India, incorporated in September 2021. The company specializes in manufacturing general Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs), corticosteroids, and sex hormones. With a focus on quality and compliance, Krishang Pharma aims to support global healthcare needs through reliable and effective pharmaceutical ingredients. The organization offers a dynamic environment for professionals who want to contribute to a scaling pharma manufacturing business. Team members can expect a culture that values integrity, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Role Description The Head of Sales is a full-time, hybrid role based in Ahmedabad, with flexibility for some work-from-home days. This position is responsible for developing and executing sales strategies for APIs, corticosteroids, and sex hormone products, with a focus on revenue growth and market expansion. Day-to-day responsibilities include leading the sales team, setting targets, monitoring performance, and providing coaching and support to achieve business objectives. The role involves managing key customer accounts, building long-term relationships with distributors and pharmaceutical clients, and identifying new business opportunities in domestic and international markets. The Head of Sales will collaborate closely with production, quality, and regulatory teams to ensure accurate product positioning, timely order fulfillment, and customer satisfaction. Regular tasks also include forecasting demand, analyzing sales data, preparing reports for senior leadership, and representing the company at industry events, conferences, and client meetings as needed.

Qualifications

  • Strong Sales and Sales Management skills to drive revenue growth, build pipelines, and manage the full sales cycle in the pharmaceutical sector.
  • Proficiency in Account Management, including relationship-building, contract negotiation, and retention of key clients.
  • Proven Team Management and leadership abilities to hire, mentor, and develop a high-performing sales team.
  • Advanced Analytical Skills to interpret market data, sales reports, and customer trends for strategic decision-making.

title: State Head
descriptionHtml:
STURLITE VOLTEDGE PRIVATE LIMITED

Job Description| Regional Sales Manager — Power (State Head, Trade)

Regional Sales Manager — Power

Sturlite Voltedge Private Limited |State Head — Trade Channel | Pan-India


FunctionSales & Business Development — Power Division (Wires, Cables & Switchgear)Level Senior Management (Regional Sales Manager / State Head)OpeningsMultiple positions — one per state / territory (see markets table below)LocationState capital or key commercial hub within the assigned territory

Reports To Joint Business Head — Power (Mr. Suresh Jain & Mr. Sandeep Kantilal)

Team SizeLeads 4–6 ASMs and 18–28 TSIs across the assigned stateTravel12–15 days per month across the state or cluster.


About Sturlite ElectricFounded in 2009 by Mr. Sanjay Jain and Mr. Mukesh Jain, Sturlite Electric is a Bengaluru-based electrical products company that has compounded at ~35% CAGR for the better part of a decade — reaching ₹700 Cr ARR through a 16,000+ partner channel spanning 25 states. The lighting portfolio that built the business is TUV Rheinland-certified and has earned Sturlite a rare distinction in the Indian electrical trade: a challenger brand that distributors and retailers respect on merit, not on price.Seventeen years into the business, the founders are taking the brand into two new categories — committing greenfield manufacturing capital at Kadi, Mehsana (Gujarat) to do it the rightway:

Wires & Cables — house wires (Flamecore+ FR-LF, Greencore+ HR-FR-LF, Ultracore+ HR-FR-LSH-LF) on Class 5 fine-flexible conductor and 99.97% electrolytic-grade copper, manufactured to IS 694 and IS 17048. Flexible/control cables, submersible cables, and communication cables (CAT 6, telephone, speaker). RoHS-clean by design, with serialised anti-counterfeit architecture.

Switchgear & MCBs — miniature circuit breakers, RCCBs, isolators, distribution boards, and the wider modular protection range for residential, commercial, and light industrial use. ISI-marked and engineered to integrate naturally with the wires range at the panel and the dealer counter.Over the next three to four years, Sturlite will grow into a multi-category electrical group of ₹2,000 Cr+ — built on four legs: lighting, wires & cables, switchgear & MCBs, and wiring devices. The team being built for the Power Division defines this next chapter. The Power Division is being built once. The people who build it own how it gets built.


The Opportunity

This is not a maintenance role in an established business. It is a state P&L leadership role in a brand-new category. The right candidatewill:


  • Enter a market where Sturlite Power has zero legacy baggage — no old pricing issues, no burned relationships, no stuck stock.
  • Leverage Sturlite's existing lighting dealer network (16,000+ partners) as a ready entry point for distributor and retailer conversations.
  • Represent a product with genuine quality credentials — ISI-marked, Class 5 conductor, copper-pure, competitively positioned against Polycab, Finolex, KEI, and RR Kabel.
  • Have the backing of an established, growth-oriented company investing seriously in the category — trade schemes, BTL support, the Sumangal electrician loyalty programme, and Ranveer Singh as brand ambassador.
  • Build a team of ASMs and TSIs over time — this role is a state P&L owner from Day 1, growing into a multi-state mandate in Phase 2.


Key Responsibilities


Key Responsibilities



1. Revenue & P&L Ownership

  • Achieve revenue plan (monthly, quarterly, annual) for the full portfolio — house wire, flexible, submersible, communication cables, and switchgear / MCBs.
  • Maintain portfolio mix discipline across the full range, tracking the Y1 baseline to Y3 steady-state trajectory.
  • Manage credit and collections at state level; keep DSO within company norms (≤ 45 days).
  • Conduct monthly business review with Joint BH — performance, market intel, and escalations.


2. Team Leadership — ASMs & TSIs

  • Lead a team of 4–6 ASMs and 18–28 TSIs across the state — hire, train, develop, and retain.
  • Assign zone territories, set targets, build beat plans; conduct joint market visits and weekly reviews.
  • Coach ASMs on distributor management, SKU-mix discipline, and Sturlite's competitive positioning.
  • Build a team culture of ownership, field discipline, and commercial accountability from Day 1.


3. Distributor Strategy & Channel Health

  • Own distributor strategy for the state — appointment, ROI management, performance reviews, conflict resolution.
  • Map the state's electrical wholesale and distribution landscape; identify and prioritise the right distributor profile for Sturlite Power.
  • Ensure distributors are adequately stocked, trained on the product, and motivated to push Sturlite actively.
  • Activate key electrical wholesale hubs — establish Sturlite Power as a visible, credible option at the counter within the first 90 days.


4. Sumangal Electrician Programme — State Execution

  • Execute the centrally-designed Sumangal electrician loyalty programme at state level; BU Head owns design, RSM owns execution.
  • Drive electrician enrolments, monthly nukkad meets, product demos, and coupon-to-order conversion across all zones.
  • Monitor Sumangal ordering velocity — ≥ 25% of enrolled electricians ordering quarterly.


5. Strategic Kitty Deployment

  • Deploy the RSM discretionary strategic kitty — for early-bird distributor offers, month-end off-take pushes, and small schemes to distributors that drive secondary off-take to retailers.
  • RSM is the sole authority for kitty deployment; ASM and below have no scheme authority.
  • Kitty quantum is set annually by the BU Head; RSM is accountable for ROI (target: ≥ ₹15 of incremental billing per ₹1 deployed).

6. Demand Planning & Supply Coordination

  • State-level demand planning and forecasting; coordinate with manufacturing for monthly supply allocation.
  • Drive new SKU launches and sub-brand traction — sampling, dealer education, electrician demos.
  • Represent Sturlite at state trade bodies, BIS audits, and electrical contractor associations.


7. Brand Visibility & Market Intelligence

  • Drive in-shop visibility — ensure branding materials, product samples, price lists, and display boards are in place at key retail counters.
  • Track competitor activity closely — Polycab, Finolex, KEI, RR Kabel, Havells — monitor pricing, schemes, new launches, and distributor moves in the state.
  • Provide monthly market intelligence reports to the Joint BH team; flag opportunities and threats in real time.

Key Performance Indicators

KPI

Target / Benchmark

Review

Revenue achievement

≥ 95% of annual plan; ≥ 90% in any quarter

Monthly

Portfolio mix discipline

Per Y1 baseline → Y3 SS trajectory; ±5pp quarterly band

Quarterly

Distributor health (ROI score)

≥ 18% ROI for ≥ 80% of distributors

Quarterly

Beat coverage

100% beat mapped by M6; ≥ 90% visit compliance

Monthly

Active billing %

30% of beat by M12 (Y1); 50% by Y3 SS

Monthly

ASM team retention

≥ 90% Y1; ≥ 95% Y2 onwards

Annual

Strategic kitty ROI

≥ ₹15 of incremental billing per ₹1 deployed

Monthly

DSO

≤ 45 days for distributors

Monthly

Sumangal — enrolment

Per state EPP target (2–3× beat annually)

Monthly

Sumangal — ordering velocity

≥ 25% of enrolled electricians ordering quarterly

Quarterly

Contractor pull-through

≥ 15% of state billing from contractor-driven retailer orders

Monthly

Qualifications & Experience

Essential

  • 12–18 years in wires / cables
  • Minimum 5 years as ASM or equivalent zone-lead role at an established player.
  • Demonstrable track record of running a ₹50+ Cr Trade P&L.
  • Multi-region or multi-state exposure preferred.
  • Team management of 15+ people including ASMs.
  • Prior experience at Polycab, Finolex, KEI, RR Kabel, Havells, V-Guard, or equivalent W&C brand.
  • Comfort with SFA / mobile-based tools and data-driven decisions.
  • Graduate (engineering preferred); MBA a plus but not mandatory.


Preferred

  • Experience with tiered distributor structures and electrician loyalty programmes.
  • Deep knowledge of the state's electrical wholesale landscape — key wholesale hubs, top distributor names.
  • Resident in (or willing to relocate to) state HQ city.
  • Regional language fluency mandatory.

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • Builder, not Maintainer: Has launched a zone, state, or category from zero before and prefers that over inheriting a settled book.
  • Channel-Credible: Can pick up the phone and get a meeting with the top 20 distributors in the territory. Reputation in the trade matters more than CV polish.
  • Commercially Literate: Reads scheme ROI, mix margin, and working capital impact natively. Will not over-spend a scheme to chase a billing number.
  • Phase-1 Mindset: Comfortable with months 1–4 being slower than plan, and disciplined enough to keep building through that period without panic-discounting.
  • Direct Communicator: Short messages, clear numbers, no theatre. Will tell the JBH when something is broken instead of dressing it up.

Self-Starter: Sets their own daily agenda, plans their own beat, and does not wait to be told where to go or what to do


What Sturlite Offers



  • Founding-team membership in an IPO-track manufacturing venture with BIS-certified domestic plant at Kadi, Mehsana (Gujarat).
  • A genuinely differentiated product portfolio — Class 5 stranded conductor, three house-wire tiers, full flexible / submersible / communication cable range, plus switchgear & MCBs.
  • Ranveer Singh as brand ambassador — meaningful pull at the dealer counter.
  • Direct working access to founders. Decisions in days, not quarters.
  • Full ownership of state (or state-cluster) P&L — empowerment with accountability, no matrix layers diluting the role.
  • Successful Phase 1 RSMs are first in line for multi-state roles as Sturlite enters Phase 2 and beyond.
  • Clear career path to National / Zone Business Head as the state business scales — Sturlite grows its leaders from within.

title: Director of Product
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Entain India is the engineering and delivery powerhouse for Entain, one of the world’s leading global sports and gaming groups. Established in Hyderabad in 2001, we’ve grown from a small tech hub into a dynamic force, delivering cutting-edge software solutions and support services that power billions of transactions for millions of users worldwide.

Our focus on quality at scale drives us to create innovative technology that supports Entain’s mission to lead the change in global sports and gaming sector. At Entain India, we make the impossible possible, together.


As Director of Product, you will be responsible for driving the vision, strategy, and execution of our product portfolio to deliver exceptional Core Platform & CRM products & services whilst achieving our business goals. You would develop and lead a world class team of product leaders across our locations and be responsible for your platform pillar experience within the Entain group for all our markets and all our brands.

In your role you are part of the Senior Product Leadership Team and will also be working with Entain’s Global Leadership, reporting to the CTO you will be part of the Platform Team.

Are you ready to launch a winning career?


What will you do:

  • You will develop and articulate a compelling and inspiring Core Platform and CRM product vision and strategy that delights our upstream services and customers. You will live and breathe the data and insights about your products, constantly seeking points of leverage that will help us achieve Entain’s broader goals and ambitions.
  • You will champion our transformation of the Platform by partnering with the Platform Engineering Director to modernise the Core Platform and CRM (reward) components which underpin all our businesses.
  • You will design a model for the core Player Account Management (PAM) services as a Platform-as-a-Service, enabling flexible integration and loose coupling.
  • You will use a techno-functional approach to design backend systems that support multiple micro frontend labels effectively.
  • You will develop, lead and coach a stellar team of product managers, guiding them in discovery, prioritization, and execution of product initiatives. By providing development, coaching, objectives and goal setting and performance management, you will ensure the team is motivated and productive, achieving real customer and business impact.
  • You will ensure that your product organisation is aligned with the broader company in pursuing the best opportunities, collaborating closely with cross-functional leaders including design, technology, compliance, commercial, finance and legal.
  • You will partner with technology and design teams to deliver a world class product offering, ensure quality, effective and timely product delivery. You will drive product metrics that demonstrate your product impact for our customers and our business. Aligning product direction and roadmap, you will be making trade-offs as necessary with key stakeholders across the business to deliver high-quality products at a predictable cadence.
  • You will serve as product evangelist both internally and externally. Present product updates and benefits to stakeholders, customers and partners


Qualifications:

  • Significant Product leadership experience managing and leading at a director level in a Product-Led organisation.
  • A demonstrated track record of successfully launching and iteratively scaling online products.
  • Strong understanding of the ecommerce landscape, including knowledge of regulations and compliance considerations when building great customer experiences.
  • Proven experience leading and developing high-performing empowered product teams.
  • Exceptional strategic thinking, analytical, and customer and business problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities, capable of collaborating with diverse teams and stakeholders.
