title: Head of Wealth & Trading
descriptionHtml:
hackajob is collaborating with Revolut to connect them with exceptional professionals for this role.

About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About The Role

Our Wealth & Trading team is at the forefront of redefining how people invest, using data-driven tools to make smarter financial decisions accessible to everyone. We operate with precision and expertise, building cutting-edge solutions that empower customers worldwide.

We're looking for a Head of Wealth & Trading to ensuring the business is safely licensed, scalable, and engineered for customers across the region.

You'll lead trading and investments, from regulatory authorisation and product strategy, through to governance, risk, and commercial performance.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

What you'll be doing

  • Defining the local wealth and trading strategy and business plan, aligning with global strategy and growth objectives
  • Leading the end-to-end build-out of the entity (people, processes, systems, governance)
  • Shaping the customer proposition (coverage, products, pricing, features, education)
  • Acting as a key senior point of contact for local regulators, supporting licence applications, approvals, and ongoing supervision
  • Designing and embedding governance frameworks
  • Ensuring full compliance with applicable securities, conduct, and consumer protection regulations, working closely with Compliance and Legal
  • Owning the first-line risk management framework for W&T, covering market, operational, conduct, technology, and regulatory risks
  • Providing clear leadership, coaching, and succession planning for the local team
  • Owning P&L delivery, including revenue, cost base, and capital efficiency

What you'll need

  • A degree in finance, economics, business, engineering, or a related field
  • Expertise in W&T within banks, brokers, fintechs, or other regulated financial institutions
  • A track record in launching, leading, or significantly transforming a retail brokerage or wealth platform
  • An understanding of retail trading and investment products (equities, ETFs, funds)
  • Knowledge of relevant securities and conduct regulatory frameworks in India
  • Experience engaging with regulators, including responding to queries, inspections, and remediation
  • Experience partnering with product and engineering teams in a digital environment

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with fixed income and other asset classes

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important Notice For Candidates

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

  • Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.
  • Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Founding Head of Customer Success & Operations
descriptionHtml:
Experience: 4.00 + years

Salary: Confidential (based on experience)

Expected Notice Period: 30 Days

Shift: (GMT+05:30) Asia/Kolkata (IST)

Opportunity Type: Office ()

Placement Type: Full Time Permanent position(Payroll and Compliance to be managed by: AI-powered B2B procurement platform)

(*Note: This is a requirement for one of Uplers' client - AI-powered B2B procurement platform)

What do you need for this opportunity?

Must have skills required:

Authority and empathy together, Comfort with senior enterprise stakeholders, CSAM, Customer succes acount manager, Sales conversion ownership, Stakeholder Management, adoption driving, ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude AI, Claude

AI-powered B2B procurement platform is Looking for:

Founding Head of Customer Success & Operations

Work Location- | Bengaluru, India

The 30-second version

WW is the AI operating system for industrial projects, tendering, estimation, procurement, vendor management, PO, GRN, and site execution on one AI-native platform. We have paying customers. Our first customer is also a strategic industry investor. We''''re well-capitalised with 3+ years of runway. AI agents already work inside our workflows today.

We''''re hiring our founding head of customer success & operations, the person who owns whether a paid pilot turns into a long-term enterprise relationship. Reports directly to the CEO. Equity in the early single-digit to early double-digit percent range, depending on profile and timing.

This is not a customer support role. This is a revenue-driver role with the unusual combination of sales, product, and tech sitting in one seat.

If you''''ve ever wanted to walk into an enterprise customer''''s office, understand a real workflow problem in the morning, and ship a working AI solution back to them by the end of the week, read on.

The market we''''re going after

Industrial capex projects in India alone create over ₹25 lakh crore of value every year. Even if just 1–2% of that value eventually gets digitized or intelligence-enabled, that''''s a ₹20,000–40,000 crore annual opportunity in India, and north of $50 billion globally.

And that''''s before the bigger monetization layers kick in:

  • Vendor monetization
  • Project financing
  • Embedded commerce
  • AI agents-as-a-service


The underlying market is enormous. The workflows are deeply broken, most large EPCs still run projects on Excel, email, and WhatsApp. The right product becomes the operating system for an entire sector. We believe WW is that product.

The product vision

We''''re building a deep AI agent that understands industrial projects from bidding to commissioning, one that works 24/7, is 10x faster and smarter than the best project manager on earth, and is impossible not to use once a team has it.

Concretely: an AI coworker embedded in every team of a contractor, tendering, estimation, procurement, engineering, finance, that does 80% of the work and only pulls a human in when judgment is genuinely needed. It works when the team is asleep. It works when they''''re not in office. It picks up emails, WhatsApp messages, vendor quotes, drawings, and BOQs from wherever they already live, and turns them into structured project intelligence.

That''''s the product. We''''re already on the path. The next few years are about making it real at enterprise scale.

Why this role matters

Our good chunk of customers come in through paid pilots. A pilot is deployed for a specific project and team. Whether that pilot converts into a long-term enterprise contract depends almost entirely on one thing: does the customer actually run their workflows on WW during the pilot, and do they see clear value from it?

That means execution quality directly determines revenue. Every pilot is a sales motion that lasts weeks, not a one-day demo. And the person owning that motion isn''''t a sales rep handing off to a CSM. It''''s one founding operator owning the entire arc, all the way to expansion.

This is the seat that decides how fast WW grows.

What Makes This Role Unusual

Most "customer success" roles are reactive: respond to tickets, manage relationships, escalate when something breaks. This role is the opposite.

It sits at the intersection of sales, product, and tech, and AI has made that combination genuinely possible for the first time.

When a customer says "we need a way to compare vendor quotes that include freight, tax, and delivery timeline trade-offs differently", you don''''t write a 12-page PRD and wait six weeks. You:

  • Sit with the procurement team for half a day and understand the actual problem
  • Use AI tools to prototype (almost ready to be deployed) a working solution in a day
  • Walk back in with something they can use
  • Close the loop with product and tech on what to harden into the core platform


You will personally ship things customers can feel. You will personally drive conversions. You will personally decide what gets built next, because you have the clearest view of where the money is.

This is a role with a builder''''s leverage, an operator''''s discipline, and a seller''''s hunger. If you have any two of those three, AI now makes the third learnable. If you have all three, this is the seat for you.

What You''''ll Actually Own

These are real problems, not bullet-point abstractions.

  • Pilot conversion. Take a signed pilot from kickoff to a converted enterprise contract. Own the timeline, the milestones, the customer''''s CFO''''s confidence, and the commercial outcome.
  • Building a repeatable pilot playbook. Today every pilot is custom. Within a few months, pilot onboarding, vendor/product data migration, workflow activation, and success measurement should be a structured, fast-moving system that runs across 5–10 simultaneous deployments.
  • Prototyping customer-specific solutions using AI. When a customer needs something the core platform doesn''''t yet do, you build the first version yourself using AI tooling, fast enough that the customer experiences progress in days, not quarters. You then work with product and tech to decide what gets absorbed into the platform.
  • Driving real adoption inside customer organisations. EPCs don''''t change behaviour easily. You''''ll work onsite when needed, train operational users, push back on internal blockers, and escalate to senior leadership when momentum slows.
  • Owning the customer feedback loop into product. You''''ll bring the sharpest, highest-signal product feedback into the company, because you''''ll have lived the workflow with the customer. And you''''ll close the loop back to the customer when fixes ship.
  • Coordinating internal execution. Vendor onboarding, tech integrations, training, data migration, all of it has to move together. You''''ll be the person making sure it does.
  • Building the customer success organization over time. Lead and grow the small CS team that exists today. Set the bar for what enterprise execution looks like at WW.
  • Building the operational dashboard for the company. Pilot status, conversion metrics, adoption depth, blockers, the founder and the team should see the full execution picture through systems you build.


What The First 90 Days Look Like

The first 90 days are focused on driving conversion on the active pilots and laying down the execution backbone. That means:

  • Going deep on every active customer, what they signed up for, what they''''re actually using, what''''s stuck, and what''''s needed to convert
  • Personally owning the next set of pilot-to-contract conversions
  • Identifying the two or three operational systems that, if built now, will make the next 10 pilots dramatically smoother
  • Building the first version of the pilot playbook and the execution dashboard
  • Establishing rhythm with the founder, product, and tech, feedback in, fixes out, customers updated


After 90 days, the work expands into scaling the team, deepening the AI-driven prototyping muscle, and building WW''''s reputation as the company that delivers in a sector that''''s been burned by enterprise software before.

What We''''re Looking For

Someone who combines:

  • 3+ Years of relevant experience in client success
  • Real ownership of enterprise/mid-size customer outcomes, implementations, deployments, or post-sale execution at companies that bought complex software
  • Strong commercial instinct, you understand that adoption is revenue, and you push accordingly. You''''re not afraid of the commercial conversation.
  • Product sense and the willingness to build, you can scope a workflow problem, mock or prototype a solution (using AI or no-code tools), and ship it. You don''''t need an engineer to validate every idea.
  • Operational discipline, you build systems, not just relationships. You can take a chaotic process and turn it into a repeatable one.
  • Comfort with senior enterprise stakeholders, project heads, CFOs, MDs. You can hold your ground in a room of people 20 years more senior.
  • Authority and empathy together, push internal teams when execution slows, while building trust with customer-side users who are nervous about change.


Strongly preferred: experience in enterprise SaaS deployments, ERP/procurement systems, management consulting, or an operations-heavy startup. Bonus if you''''ve worked in or around the industrial/EPC/procurement world.

Strong pluses:

  • Hands-on with AI tools for prototyping (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, no-code AI builders, etc.)
  • Experience selling, expanding, or renewing enterprise contracts
  • Experience working directly with founders
  • Experience leading a small but high-discipline team


The setup

  • Team: Lean team of 5 today, including a small existing customer success function that this person will inherit and grow.
  • Reporting line: Directly to the CEO (Siddharth). Operates as a founding member of the company.
  • Location: Bengaluru. Frequent onsite engagement with customers, primarily in industrial hubs across India.
  • Funding & runway: Well-capitalised by a strategic industry investor. Over 3 years of runway. We are not in fundraising-survival mode we''''re in build-and-scale mode.


Why someone should join

To put it plainly:

  • The market is enormous and real, ₹25+ lakh crore of annual industrial capex in India alone, $50B+ globally for the digitization layer.
  • Customer demand is already validated, paying customers, strategic investor from the industry.
  • This is a revenue-driver seat, every pilot you convert is a multi-year enterprise contract.
  • AI has made this role genuinely powerful, you can understand a problem on Monday and ship a working solution by Friday. No other generation of operators has had this leverage.
  • The upside is real ownership, early single to early double-digit equity, with a credible path to a major outcome.
  • The team is small and the work is foundational, what you build in the first year shapes the next decade.


How to apply for this opportunity?

  • Step 1: Click On Apply! And Register or Login on our portal.
  • Step 2: Complete the Screening Form & Upload updated Resume
  • Step 3: Increase your chances to get shortlisted & meet the client for the Interview!


About Uplers:

Our goal is to make hiring reliable, simple, and fast. Our role will be to help all our talents find and apply for relevant contractual onsite opportunities and progress in their career. We will support any grievances or challenges you may face during the engagement.

(Note: There are many more opportunities apart from this on the portal. Depending on the assessments you clear, you can apply for them as well).

So, if you are ready for a new challenge, a great work environment, and an opportunity to take your career to the next level, don't hesitate to apply today. We are waiting for you!

What The First 90 Days Look Like

The first 90 days are focused on driving conversion on the active pilots and laying down the execution backbone. That means:



- Going deep on every active customer, what they signed up for, what they''''re actually using, what''''s stuck, and what''''s needed to convert
- Personally owning the next set of pilot-to-contract conversions
- Identifying the two or three operational systems that, if built now, will make the next 10 pilots dramatically smoother
- Building the first version of the pilot playbook and the execution dashboard
- Establishing rhythm with the founder, product, and tech, feedback in, fixes out, customers updated


After 90 days, the work expands into scaling the team, deepening the AI-driven prototyping muscle, and building WW''''s reputation as the company that delivers in a sector that''''s been burned by enterprise software before.

What We''''re Looking For

Someone who combines:



- 3+ Years of relevant experience in client success
- Real ownership of enterprise/mid-size customer outcomes, implementations, deployments, or post-sale execution at companies that bought complex software
- Strong commercial instinct, you understand that adoption is revenue, and you push accordingly. You''''re not afraid of the commercial conversation.
- Product sense and the willingness to build, you can scope a workflow problem, mock or prototype a solution (using AI or no-code tools), and ship it. You don''''t need an engineer to validate every idea.
- Operational discipline, you build systems, not just relationships. You can take a chaotic process and turn it into a repeatable one.
- Comfort with senior enterprise stakeholders, project heads, CFOs, MDs. You can hold your ground in a room of people 20 years more senior.
- Authority and empathy together, push internal teams when execution slows, while building trust with customer-side users who are nervous about change.


Strongly preferred: experience in enterprise SaaS deployments, ERP/procurement systems, management consulting, or an operations-heavy startup. Bonus if you''''ve worked in or around the industrial/EPC/procurement world.

Strong pluses:



- Hands-on with AI tools for prototyping (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, no-code AI builders, etc.)
- Experience selling, expanding, or renewing enterprise contracts
- Experience working directly with founders
- Experience leading a small but high-discipline team


The setup



- Team: Lean team of 5 today, including a small existing customer success function that this person will inherit and grow.
- Reporting line: Directly to the CEO (Siddharth). Operates as a founding member of the company.
- Location: Bengaluru. Frequent onsite engagement with customers, primarily in industrial hubs across India.
- Funding & runway: Well-capitalised by a strategic industry investor. Over 3 years of runway. We are not in fundraising-survival mode we''''re in build-and-scale mode.


Why someone should join

To put it plainly:



- The market is enormous and real, ₹25+ lakh crore of annual industrial capex in India alone, $50B+ globally for the digitization layer.
- Customer demand is already validated, paying customers, strategic investor from the industry.
- This is a revenue-driver seat, every pilot you convert is a multi-year enterprise contract.
- AI has made this role genuinely powerful, you can understand a problem on Monday and ship a working solution by Friday. No other generation of operators has had this leverage.
- The upside is real ownership, early single to early double-digit equity, with a credible path to a major outcome.
- The team is small and the work is foundational, what you build in the first year shapes the next decade.


How to apply for this opportunity?



- Step 1: Click On Apply! And Register or Login on our portal.
- Step 2: Complete the Screening Form & Upload updated Resume
- Step 3: Increase your chances to get shortlisted & meet the client for the Interview!


About Uplers:

Our goal is to make hiring reliable, simple, and fast. Our role will be to help all our talents find and apply for relevant contractual onsite opportunities and progress in their career. We will support any grievances or challenges you may face during the engagement.

(Note: There are many more opportunities apart from this on the portal. Depending on the assessments you clear, you can apply for them as well).

So, if you are ready for a new challenge, a great work environment, and an opportunity to take your career to the next level, don't hesitate to apply today. We are waiting for you!

Enriching Lives Winning as ONE

ABC Company Info

Aditya Birla Capital Limited ("ABCL") is the holding company for the financial services businesses of the Aditya Birla Group. With subsidiaries/JVs that have a strong presence across Protecting, Investing and Financing solutions, ABCL is a financial solutions group that caters to the diverse needs of its customers across their life cycle. Powered by more than 38,000 employees, the businesses of ABCL have a nationwide reach with over 1300 branches, more than 2,00,000 agents/channel partners and various bank partners.

Aditya Birla Finance Limited

Aditya Birla Finance Limited (“ABFL”), a subsidiary of Aditya Birla Capital Limited, is among the leading well-diversified non-banking financial services company in India. ABFL offers customized solutions in the areas of personal finance, mortgage finance, SME finance, corporate finance, wealth management, debt capital markets and loan syndication.

What makes an ideal ABC Citizen?

At ABC, we are constantly on the lookout for individuals who resonate with our 5 core values of Speed, Passion, Integrity, Seamlessness and commitment and live them every day, while also understanding our vision. We believe in building leaders who thrive on challenges, take the onus of creating and sustaining strong teams, and forms strong networks as a result of effective relationship-building.

Role Details

 Business

Aditya Birla Capital

Unit

Aditya Birla Finance Limited

Location

Mumbai

Role

Partner Client Relations / Senior Partner Client Relations

Department

Wealth HNI & CTS

Eligibility Criteria

Masters in Finance, 5-7 Years of Relevant Experience

Required Skills & Competencies

  • Strong local network
  • Market and investment product knowledge
  • Ability to interpret market trends
  • High collaboration
  • Good communication and negotiation skills
  • Target orientation
  • Acquisition experience/expertise
  • Customer centricity
  • Client acquisition with client retention & deepening

Key Responsibilities

 Undertake new client acquisition, retention & growth

  • Identify and acquire new customer for CTS.
  • To execute monthly sales plan to acquire large prospective clients and ensure regular contact with all mapped clients through regular weekly / monthly calls. Daily tracking of targets & personal meeting with clients. To identify potential clients (Corporates/FIs) through referral networks and other channel of sourcing new customers like ads, directories of various corporate associations, internet etc.
  • To ensure 100% client penetration for business sourced & enabling increase in share of wallet & revenues.
  • To undertake joint calls with research team / portfolio review of clients with research team / worksite for corporate clients.
  • To work with the retail teams in arranging worksites in the premises of Institutional clients.

Achieve targeted profitability & fee income

  • To maintain sales volumes & achieve targeted revenue from all customers/ products.
  • To share regular market updates with clients and provide right investment solution.
  • To maintain projected fee income at budgeted numbers and undertake cross selling initiatives to achieve them.

Contribute to customer satisfaction initiatives

  • To follow the ethical and fair practices code for selling products.
  • To ensure regular availability of research material and inputs to the clients.
  • To ensure that client promises are kept and their grievances are adequately addressed or highlighted.
  • To keep up breast of the latest developments & report to the Regional Head, research team of the upcoming client requirements to innovate the product/service mix.

Ensure policy adherence and documentation

  • To be aware of all critical policies & procedures & ensure compliance with them.
  • To help the risk & review process through continual monitoring of client profile & ensuring thorough documentation relating to proposals & KYC procedures.
  • To coordinate with CSM and market intermediaries like MFs & banks for smooth transaction and operations.

Formulate periodic MIS and track competitor moves and report them periodically

  • To send detailed periodic activity & sales reports to the Teal Lead.
  • To monitor competitor moves and products, marketing initiatives and report the same to the management, product and research teams.

Contribute in skill enhancement

  • To ensure ongoing self development - attend internal and external training programs, other relevant certifications that enhances the skills in the financial sales services.

Aditya Birla Capital is committed to provide equal opportunity to all in employment and prohibits discrimination or harassment in any form on the basis of race, colour, religion, ethnicity, age, gender, disability or any other characteristic protected by law.   • Any job offer made against a service charge or security deposit or processing fees or background verification expenses or any other terms, whether refundable or non-refundable should be considered fake.

descriptionHtml:
Position: Finance Head – Manufacturing Unit

Location: Ulhasnagar

Experience: 5+ Years

Qualification: Chartered Accountant (CA) – Mandatory

Employment Type: Full-Time

Reporting To: Founder


Key Responsibilities


- Financial Management: Lead end-to-end finance and accounts operations; prepare budgets, forecasts, and business plans; and drive profitability improvements.

- Manufacturing Finance & Costing: Manage product costing, inventory valuation, and material consumption. Implement cost control measures and analyze manufacturing KPIs.

- Working Capital & Cash Flow: Manage cash flow forecasting and optimize working capital and fund utilization.

- Financial Reporting & Compliance: Oversee MIS, GST, TDS, and Income Tax compliance. Coordinate audits and maintain strong financial controls.

- SAP & Process Improvement: Drive SAP-based financial processes and automation to ensure data integrity.

- Business Partnering: Support Production, Supply Chain, and Procurement teams with strategic insights and CapEx planning.

- Team Management: Lead and develop the finance and accounts team.


Candidate Profile


- Mandatory: Chartered Accountant (CA) with 5+ years of post-qualification experience. Must be SAP certified with a strong background in manufacturing finance (Costing, Budgeting, and Compliance).

- Preferred: Experience in Apparel, Fashion, Retail, or FMCG sectors, specifically with factory finance operations.

- Technical Skills: FP&A, Cost Accounting, Cash Flow Management, GST & Tax Compliance, and SAP ERP.

title: Product Owner
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

About Ramboll

Founded in Denmark, Ramboll is a foundation-owned people company. We have more than 18,000 experts working across our global operations in 35 countries. Our experts are leaders in their fields, developing and delivering innovative solutions in diverse markets including Buildings, Transport, Planning & Urban Design, Water, Environment & Health, Energy, and Management Consulting. We invite you to contribute to a more sustainable future working in an open, collaborative, and empowering company. Combining local experience with global knowledge, we together shape the societies of tomorrow.

Ramboll in India

Ramboll has more than 1800+ experts working across five offices in India applying their passion to deliver innovative solutions in markets as diverse as Buildings, Transport, Planning & Urban Design, Water, Environment & Health and Energy. Founded in Denmark, Ramboll is a people company. We invite you to contribute to a sustainable future working in an open, collaborative and empowering culture.

Job Description

Product Owner – Digital Employee Journey

Chennai, India

Our 18,000 colleagues use their expertise every day to shape sustainable societies where people and nature flourish. In the Digital Employee Journey function at Ramboll, we are committed to removing friction and enabling our colleagues with great technology and capabilities so that they can focus on this important mission.

Are you energised by the possibilities of AI to improve how people access information and support? Are you motivated to help shape a digital employee experience that enables Ramboll's 18,000+ colleagues across 35 countries? Are you a curious, employee-first product manager who believes that great experiences are built on well-designed workflows and well-governed systems?

If this sounds like you, or you're curious to learn more, then this role could be the perfect opportunity. Join our Digital Employee Journey team as our new Product Owner.

Your new role

As our new Product Owner, you will join the Digital Employee Journey team on a permanent basis, reporting to the Head of Digital Employee Journey and working closely day-to-day to support our Senior Product owners for Digital Employee Support and Digital Workplace.

Your role will evolve with business needs for product management of our core employee-facing products for collaboration, communication, support, and general productivity.

Your focus during the first 5 months of this permanent position will be on covering key areas of the Digital Employee Support product area while the Senior Product owner is on parental leave. This includes how employees access support, self-service, and knowledge across digital channels such as assisted support and ServiceNow.

You will also collaborate with the Digital Workplace Senior Product Owner on knowledge management and digital employee experience (DEX) topics.

Based in our Chennai office, you will work alongside a global, international community of Tech Partners, Tech Operations colleagues, engineering and build partners, data and AI specialists, the Digital Adoption team, and enabling functions at Ramboll. You will be exposed to a wide range of stakeholders across the business with the opportunity to develop a strong network across our business.

Expect a collaborative, outcomes-driven environment where employee advocacy, AI-enabled experiences, and product ownership are championed.

Your key responsibilities will be:


  • Owning employee experience-led product roadmaps and acting as the day-to-day decision point for cross-product trade-offs with key stakeholders — framing product work in terms of experience outcomes and value created in end-to-end employee journeys following established principles and standards. Enforcing standards and resolving experience-level questions and escalations (e.g. where multiple SME stakeholders are involved). Defining requirements for operational execution by the Tech Operations team.
  • Interim covering the Digital Employee Support product ownership —Setting requirements, frameworks and roadmap for how digital employee support services are designed across Ramboll, with a focus on consistency, scalability, and employee centricity. This includes standardising patterns for support journeys across service areas such as technology, workplace, and HR-related services.
  • Supporting Senior Product Owners for Digital Workplace and Digital Employee Support— providing day-to-day support and sparring across both product areas, with a particular focus in your first several months on knowledge management and DEX topics that span Digital Employee Support and the Digital Workplace.
  • Co-developing the knowledge management framework as a cross-team collaboration — partnering with the Digital Workplace product team, the adoption team, and other key stakeholders across our enabling functions and the business to ensure content is user-centric, structured for scale, and fit for both human-assisted and AI-driven support.
  • Further developing our DEX and efficiency metrics — building on existing measurement approaches to mature how we track digital employee experience and efficiency, contributing to broader Ramboll Tech KPIs, and turning product usage and support data into meaningful insight that informs prioritization and continuous improvement.


Qualifications

About you


  • Proven experience as a Product Owner for employee-facing support and/or digital workplace products in a large matrix organization, with a track record of developing and owning a product roadmap, managing a product budget, and leading agile sprints for continuous improvement.
  • Hands-on experience with enterprise platforms — ServiceNow and the Microsoft 365 suite are an advantage — including how these products support employee service delivery, self-service, knowledge, and the everyday digital workplace.
  • Energised by the possibilities of AI — you see a future where friction to accessing information and services is removed, while systems of record and SME accountability remain clear and well governed in the backend; working knowledge of AI within Enterprise Service Management systems and/or Microsoft 365 (Office, OneNote, Teams, OneDrive), SharePoint (intranet and storage platform governance), and Power Platform is a strong advantage. Highlight any demonstrated experience in these systems (or similar) in your application.
  • Strong product management driven by data and value creation — able to keep initiatives moving, manage a prioritised backlog across multiple stakeholders, and translate data from a wide range of sources (including product usage data) into strategies and meaningful outcomes for employees and the business. Demonstrating KPI/SLA creation and tracking is a strong advantage.
  • Excellent stakeholder and people skills — able to handle escalations and user questions independently, conduct your own research, and bring a can-do attitude to finding the right person or solution; demonstrate excellent communication skills in English.


Additional Information

What we can offer you


  • Commitment to your development
  • Leaders guided by our Leadership Principles
  • A culture that welcomes you as the unique person you are
  • Inspiration from colleagues, clients, and projects
  • The long-term thinking of a foundation-owned company
  • Flexible work environment
  • Medical and life insurance
  • Generous leave entitlement each calendar year
  • Opportunities to collaborate with international teams across 35 countries.


Ready to join us?

Please submit your application and CV online. We invite diversity in all its forms and encourage applicants from all groups to apply.

We recognise that some candidates only apply when they tick every box. However, passion and potential often outweigh a perfect resume and Ramboll's supportive learning culture can help you grow. So if this role resonates with you but you don't meet all the requirements, we encourage you to apply. You might be the perfect fit for this opportunity or another within our team.

Deadline: 30-June-25

"At Ramboll we attract bright minds that can demonstrate critical thinking and share our values of empathy and integrity, particularly when we work with AI. In your application please share an example of how you have demonstrated this way of working with AI to improve your work and what you have learned from working this way."

Work at the heart of sustainable change with Ramboll

Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. As a foundation-owned people company, founded in Denmark, we believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that's where we start – and how we work. Our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act and being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. Ramboll employs more than 18,000 people globally across 35 countries. Ramboll experts deliver innovative solutions across Buildings, Transport, Water, Environment & Health, Energy, Management Consulting, and Architecture & Landscape. Combining local experience with global knowledge, we help shape the societies of tomorrow.

Equality, Diversity, and Inclusion

Equality, diversity, and inclusion are at the heart of what we do. At Ramboll, we believe that diversity is a strength and that different experiences and perspectives are essential to creating truly sustainable societies. We are committed to providing an inclusive and supportive work environment where everyone is able to flourish and reach their potential. We also know how important it is to achieve the right balance of where, when, and how much you work. At Ramboll, we offer flexibility as part of our positive and inclusive approach to work. We invite applications from candidates of all backgrounds and characteristics. Please let us know if there are any changes we could make to the application process to make it more comfortable for you

- Energised by the possibilities of AI — you see a future where friction to accessing information and services is removed, while systems of record and SME accountability remain clear and well governed in the backend; working knowledge of AI within Enterprise Service Management systems and/or Microsoft 365 (Office, OneNote, Teams, OneDrive), SharePoint (intranet and storage platform governance), and Power Platform is a strong advantage. Highlight any demonstrated experience in these systems (or similar) in your application. 
- Strong product management driven by data and value creation — able to keep initiatives moving, manage a prioritised backlog across multiple stakeholders, and translate data from a wide range of sources (including product usage data) into strategies and meaningful outcomes for employees and the business. Demonstrating KPI/SLA creation and tracking is a strong advantage.
- Excellent stakeholder and people skills — able to handle escalations and user questions independently, conduct your own research, and bring a can-do attitude to finding the right person or solution; demonstrate excellent communication skills in English.


Additional Information

What we can offer you




- Commitment to your development
- Leaders guided by our Leadership Principles
- A culture that welcomes you as the unique person you are
- Inspiration from colleagues, clients, and projects
- The long-term thinking of a foundation-owned company
- Flexible work environment
- Medical and life insurance
- Generous leave entitlement each calendar year
- Opportunities to collaborate with international teams across 35 countries.


Ready to join us?

Please submit your application and CV online. We invite diversity in all its forms and encourage applicants from all groups to apply.

We recognise that some candidates only apply when they tick every box. However, passion and potential often outweigh a perfect resume and Ramboll's supportive learning culture can help you grow. So if this role resonates with you but you don't meet all the requirements, we encourage you to apply. You might be the perfect fit for this opportunity or another within our team.

Deadline: 30-June-25

"At Ramboll we attract bright minds that can demonstrate critical thinking and share our values of empathy and integrity, particularly when we work with AI. In your application please share an example of how you have demonstrated this way of working with AI to improve your work and what you have learned from working this way."

Work at the heart of sustainable change with Ramboll

Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. As a foundation-owned people company, founded in Denmark, we believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that's where we start – and how we work. Our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act and being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. Ramboll employs more than 18,000 people globally across 35 countries. Ramboll experts deliver innovative solutions across Buildings, Transport, Water, Environment & Health, Energy, Management Consulting, and Architecture & Landscape. Combining local experience with global knowledge, we help shape the societies of tomorrow.

Equality, Diversity, and Inclusion

Equality, diversity, and inclusion are at the heart of what we do. At Ramboll, we believe that diversity is a strength and that different experiences and perspectives are essential to creating truly sustainable societies. We are committed to providing an inclusive and supportive work environment where everyone is able to flourish and reach their potential. We also know how important it is to achieve the right balance of where, when, and how much you work. At Ramboll, we offer flexibility as part of our positive and inclusive approach to work. We invite applications from candidates of all backgrounds and characteristics. Please let us know if there are any changes we could make to the application process to make it more comfortable for you

title: Custody Product Development Manager CPL- Banking Platform and Migration - Vice President
descriptionHtml:
The Product organization is recruiting for an experienced individual covering core banking (DDA) platform supporting the cash payments and liquidity Product Development lead.

The individual will partner with the Product team, Global Delivery (operations) and Technology to execute on the overall cash product development initiatives and agenda focused on build a modern banking (DDA) platform and associated services, in alignment with Custody product strategic objective to strengthen State Street’s position in the industry. State Street’s product organisation is leading an exciting period of transformation for the business and requires experienced individuals to take the business forward.

The role will Initiate and support designing and developing the strategic banking platform and support the strategy to decommission legacy platforms including the migration to strategic platform to support client growth, enhance client experience and operating model.

This role includes driving and overseeing execution of approved product change/development initiatives, specifically supporting the parallel production strategy to build out the strategic platform and seamless migration of clients. This requires ability to perform as a Product Owner for an Agile room(s) and manage the collection of input from subject matter experts, operations teams, product managers, client service teams and/or our clients for the purpose of developing complete and substantive business requirements. The position requires the ability to document use cases and operational flows as well as support colleagues with less experience develop those skills while also acting as gatekeeper to ensure quality documentation is generated and any shortcomings are addressed prior to releasing the documents for downstream use. Development of efficient operating models that include effective business controls will be a job function of the successful candidate.

Function

The role requires the depth and expertise to effectively develop requirements and solutions, such as stories/epics, develop and groom backlog required for the migration tools and production parallel and have the SME knowledge to execute on the overall custody product development initiatives and agenda described above. The role will support the Cash, Payments and Liquidity lead. The person would focus on the production parallel migration and validation strategy, and work closely with business and IT to develop comprehensive solution to support tranche migrations across all global locations (17 branches).

Responsibilities

The role will have responsibility for the following

  • Act as the Product Owner leading the work required to efficiently execute the production parallel and client migration strategy
  • Support the development and analysis of product-related change, including commercially-viable and client focused business cases, with prioritization and approval of product, operational and regulatory change.
  • Ensure change remains aligned to existing regulation and/or internal policies.
  • Requires understanding of the local requirements for both deployment and ongoing regulatory compliance etc.
  • Support design and efficiency of the operating model, standards and technical stack/architecture, with an objective to simplify where possible working with the Product Management, Technology and Global Delivery.
  • Work with the core banking applications team to establish requirements and manage Agile development required to design and develop solutions for complex payments and banking operations
  • Manage team members working on defect identification, triage and remediation including identification of root cause and resolution management as appropriate
  • Support annual planning and funding prioritization activities
  • Oversee archival of documentation and other program artifacts associated with development and implementation activities so that they are maintained for future business needs and audit purposes


Skills

  • Ability to apply knowledge of system behavior and business requirements as well as industry knowledge and best practices to design and test solutions
  • Ability to clearly articulate impact of any changes to team members, testers and business end users to ensure that testing and acceptance processes are completed successfully; ability to train and develop these skills in more junior team members or direct reports
  • Ability to oversee, review and edit documentation to ensure completeness and clarity prior to submitting for use in developing solutions
  • Ability to write Agile stories and epics, establish a backlog and groom that backlog is desired as is experience with developing these skills in our global team
  • Work well within a virtual team that includes members from across State Streets global operations, product and IT development teams, contractors, software vendors and other industry participants to design, develop, test and implement solutions that support current and future business requirements
  • Subject matter knowledge
  • Strong analytical skills
  • Prior experience of successfully delivering change in a complex environment whilst managing competing environments, and delivering projects using Agile and Waterfall techniques
  • Proven change agent with track record of delivery
  • Track record of engagement with complex clients, solutioning operating models and translating requirements into feature function capability for State Street Custody platform
  • Strong stakeholder management skills with an ability to navigate organisation through the solution delivery cycle


Experience

  • Product and operational background or experience with payments and deposit banking services is desirable
  • Experience with implementing or operating Temenos’s Transact is desirable as is a level of technical familiarity with one or more of the global payment networks or messaging standards used by State Street such as: ISO 20022 pacs and camt messages, Fedwire, CHIPS, ACH, Target2 or SEPA.
  • Agile experience as a Product Owner or Principle Product Owner is desired
  • Seasoned VP with 7+ years’ experience in Securities Services
  • Worked in Product organizations in prior roles
  • Operated at a global level
  • Prior experience working in Operations and/or technology


Outcomes expected from the roles

  • In depth understanding of payments and deposit banking products; seamless client migrations and decommissioning of legacy branches
  • Proactive input and idea generation for product development roadmap
  • Maintain up to date understanding of local regulatory impacts
  • Responsible for issue and risk escalation
  • Project /initiative ownership as requested, with appropriate reporting (with PMO) of prioritised and approved change
  • Appropriate governance and audit trail on documentation of all key decisions and actions.


Split Of Role

  • Product Design & Development : 35%
  • Business Analysis: 60%
  • Market / Client interaction: 5%


About State Street

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law.

Discover more information on jobs at StateStreet.com/careers

Read our CEO Statement

title: Head of Engineering
descriptionHtml:
About Tide

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide Facts

  • Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
  • Over 2 million members: 900,000 UK and 1,100,000 in India and growing rapidly
  • Over $300 million raised in funding
  • Over 2,800 Tideans globally
  • Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
  • We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

About The Team

The Commercial Services unit is a high-growth, high-impact department dedicated to redefining how businesses trade. Structured around two strategic pillars—Buy and Sell—we build world-class tools that help members launch products, expand sales, and foster customer loyalty.

As part of the Sell pillar, the Commerce team focuses on the commerce product suite, enabling retail and service-sector members to conduct sales seamlessly both online and in person. Buy pillar of Commerce, your mission is to revolutionize the procurement experience for SMEs globally—making it faster, more transparent, and more cost-effective

About The Role

As the Head of Engineering for Commercial services you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of Tide’s commercial services platform. This is a senior technical leadership position with significant influence over architecture, engineering strategy, and technical execution. You will lead and mentor Engineering Managers and senior engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and scalable engineering practices.

As Head Of Engineering You Will Be

  • Defining and driving the architectural direction for Tide’s Commercial Services offerings, ensuring scalability, resilience, and compliance.
  • Leading the design and development of high-quality credit products.
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams (Product, Compliance, Business) to enhance Tide’s Commercial Services team.
  • Overseeing integrations with third-party providers, ensuring seamless technical delivery.
  • Providing hands-on technical guidance, getting directly involved in architecture, design, and engineering decisions.
  • Championing engineering best practices, including system design, security, and software development standards.
  • Mentoring engineers and Engineering Managers, fostering a culture of learning, ownership, and technical excellence.
  • Influencing Tide’s overall technical strategy as we scale our Intermediated Commercial Services globally.

What We Are Looking For

  • 10+ years of backend engineering experience, with at least 3 years in senior engineering leadership roles.
  • Strong experience with microservices, event-driven architectures, and distributed systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage AI tools and LLMs to improve engineering productivity, software quality, and delivery velocity.
  • Demonstrated experience in building scalable, resilient, fault-tolerant systems.
  • Breadth of technical knowledge with depth in at least one technology stack — experience with our stack is not essential, but an ability to quickly understand and lead in a new environment is critical.
  • Proven track record of delivering complex systems and third-party integrations.
  • Ability to translate strategic business goals into a clear technical roadmap and communicate the rationale behind technical decisions.
  • Strong mentoring skills and the ability to build and inspire high-performing engineering teams.

OUR TECH STACK

  • Java 17, Spring Boot and JOOQ to build the RESTful APIs of our microservices
  • Event-driven architecture with messages over SNS+SQS and Kafka to make them reliable
  • Primary datastores are MySQL and PostgreSQL via RDS or Aurora (we are heavy AWS users)
  • Docker, Terraform, EKS/Kubernetes used by the Cloud team to run the platform
  • DataDog, ElasticSearch/Fluentd/Kibana and Rollbar to keep it running
  • GitHub with GitHub actions for Sonarcloud, Snyk and solid JUnit/Pact testing to power the CI/CD pipelines (new joiners are encouraged to have something deployed to production in their first 2 weeks)

What You’ll Get In Return

  • Competitive Compensation - competitive salary and share options
  • Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
  • Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
  • Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
  • Health Insurance – Private family insurance with additional OPD coverage and top-up options.
  • Life & Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.
  • Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
  • Volunteering & Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
  • Learning & Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
  • WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
  • Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office
  • Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.
  • Snacks & Meals – Office perks with snacks, coffee, tea, and lunch (location dependent).

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING

At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.

Disclaimer

It Has Come To Our Attention That Individuals Or Agencies Are Falsely Claiming To Represent Tide And Are Reaching Out To Candidates Regarding Job Opportunities. Please Be Aware That

  • Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.
  • All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel.
  • Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide.co email address.
  • Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.

If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide.co

Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.

Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy.

Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice.

title: Head of Engineering
descriptionHtml:
About Tide

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide Facts

  • Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
  • Over 2 million members: 900,000 UK and 1,100,000 in India and growing rapidly
  • Over $300 million raised in funding
  • Over 2,800 Tideans globally
  • Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
  • We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

About The Team

The Commercial Services unit is a high-growth, high-impact department dedicated to redefining how businesses trade. Structured around two strategic pillars—Buy and Sell—we build world-class tools that help members launch products, expand sales, and foster customer loyalty.

As part of the Sell pillar, the Commerce team focuses on the commerce product suite, enabling retail and service-sector members to conduct sales seamlessly both online and in person. Buy pillar of Commerce, your mission is to revolutionize the procurement experience for SMEs globally—making it faster, more transparent, and more cost-effective

About The Role

As the Head of Engineering for Commercial services you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of Tide’s commercial services platform. This is a senior technical leadership position with significant influence over architecture, engineering strategy, and technical execution. You will lead and mentor Engineering Managers and senior engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and scalable engineering practices.

As Head Of Engineering You Will Be

  • Defining and driving the architectural direction for Tide’s Commercial Services offerings, ensuring scalability, resilience, and compliance.
  • Leading the design and development of high-quality credit products.
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams (Product, Compliance, Business) to enhance Tide’s Commercial Services team.
  • Overseeing integrations with third-party providers, ensuring seamless technical delivery.
  • Providing hands-on technical guidance, getting directly involved in architecture, design, and engineering decisions.
  • Championing engineering best practices, including system design, security, and software development standards.
  • Mentoring engineers and Engineering Managers, fostering a culture of learning, ownership, and technical excellence.
  • Influencing Tide’s overall technical strategy as we scale our Intermediated Commercial Services globally.

What We Are Looking For

  • 10+ years of backend engineering experience, with at least 3 years in senior engineering leadership roles.
  • Strong experience with microservices, event-driven architectures, and distributed systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage AI tools and LLMs to improve engineering productivity, software quality, and delivery velocity.
  • Demonstrated experience in building scalable, resilient, fault-tolerant systems.
  • Breadth of technical knowledge with depth in at least one technology stack — experience with our stack is not essential, but an ability to quickly understand and lead in a new environment is critical.
  • Proven track record of delivering complex systems and third-party integrations.
  • Ability to translate strategic business goals into a clear technical roadmap and communicate the rationale behind technical decisions.
  • Strong mentoring skills and the ability to build and inspire high-performing engineering teams.

OUR TECH STACK

  • Java 17, Spring Boot and JOOQ to build the RESTful APIs of our microservices
  • Event-driven architecture with messages over SNS+SQS and Kafka to make them reliable
  • Primary datastores are MySQL and PostgreSQL via RDS or Aurora (we are heavy AWS users)
  • Docker, Terraform, EKS/Kubernetes used by the Cloud team to run the platform
  • DataDog, ElasticSearch/Fluentd/Kibana and Rollbar to keep it running
  • GitHub with GitHub actions for Sonarcloud, Snyk and solid JUnit/Pact testing to power the CI/CD pipelines (new joiners are encouraged to have something deployed to production in their first 2 weeks)

What You’ll Get In Return

  • Competitive Compensation - competitive salary and share options
  • Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
  • Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
  • Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
  • Health Insurance – Private family insurance with additional OPD coverage and top-up options.
  • Life & Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.
  • Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
  • Volunteering & Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
  • Learning & Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
  • WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
  • Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office
  • Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.
  • Snacks & Meals – Office perks with snacks, coffee, tea, and lunch (location dependent).

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING

At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.

Disclaimer

It Has Come To Our Attention That Individuals Or Agencies Are Falsely Claiming To Represent Tide And Are Reaching Out To Candidates Regarding Job Opportunities. Please Be Aware That

  • Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.
  • All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel.
  • Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide.co email address.
  • Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.

If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide.co

Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.

Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy.

Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice.

title: Staff Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Propsoch

Propsoch is building India’s most advanced real estate due diligence platform — helping affluent homebuyers make informed property decisions through deep research, technology, and advisory.

We work with senior professionals, tech leaders, consultants, doctors, and lawyers who value transparency, expertise, and data-driven decision-making while making one of the biggest financial decisions of their lives.


Why this role matters

We’re at a pivotal stage of growth. Over the next 12–18 months, we aim to scale from a high-touch service-led business into a technology-enabled platform that can support 10x growth without linearly scaling headcount.

We’re looking for our first Head of Engineering to build and lead the engineering organization from the ground up.


What you’ll own

• Build and scale the engineering team from 3 → 13 engineers

• Lead backend, frontend, QA, infra, and AI-powered product development

• Establish engineering culture, velocity, hiring standards, and technical processes

• Architect systems for scale, reliability, and multi-city expansion

• Partner closely with Product, Design, CX, and founders to ship high-impact products

• Drive automation and AI tooling that reduces operational dependency and improves customer experience

• Stay hands-on with architecture, code reviews, debugging, and critical technical decisions


What we’re looking for

• 8+ years of software engineering experience

• 3+ years managing engineering teams

• Startup or scale-up experience (0→1 or 1→10 environments)

• Strong hands-on technical depth across modern web stacks

• Experience hiring and leading high-performing engineering teams

• Strong product thinking and execution mindset

• Familiarity with AI/LLM-powered products is a strong plus


Tech Stack

Frontend: React, Next.js

Backend: Node.js / Python

Infra: AWS

Data: PostgreSQL / MySQL

AI Stack: LLM workflows, automation systems, AI-assisted tooling


Why join us

• Build the engineering function from scratch

• High ownership and autonomy

• Work directly with founders

• Meaningful impact in a massive category

• Strong growth opportunity toward VP Eng / CTO trajectory

• Competitive compensation + meaningful equity


📩 To apply, send your resume / LinkedIn profile to: people@propsoch.com


Please include:

• Current & Expected CTC

• Notice Period

• A short note on a challenging engineering or scaling problem you solved
